jobs.jobDescription:
Role Overview:

As a Business Development Rep at Defense Unicorns, you will play a pivotal role in the company's success by identifying, cultivating, and managing new opportunities, partnerships and relationships within the ecosystem. You will leverage your deep understanding of market trends and industries to develop effective strategies for delivering mission capabilities. This position requires a strategic thinker and excellent communicator.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Research and analyze market trends and identify opportunities for Defense Unicorns’ capabilities to deliver mission value.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with partners, and stakeholders. Act as a primary point of contact, understanding mission needs and tailoring our capabilities to meet those needs effectively.
  • Lead negotiations, prepare proposals, and close deals with clients to drive revenue growth. Negotiate terms and conditions that are mutually beneficial for both the company and the client.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive technology driven strategies that align with the company's goals and objectives. Collaborate with the executive team to ensure seamless integration with overall company strategy.
  • Stay updated with industry news, market trends, and competitor activities. Use this knowledge to make informed decisions and refine technology driven strategies.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure a cohesive approach to business development initiatives. Collaborate to enhance product offerings and customer experience.
  • Prepare regular reports on business development activities, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and analyze the effectiveness of various strategies. Use data-driven insights to refine approaches and achieve better results.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • Deep Autonomous and Unmanned Systems experience
  • Demonstrated expertise and established credibility in domain-specific technology, strategic planning, business development, or a related role within the tech industry or Department of Defense
  • Demonstrated success in building and nurturing relationships, negotiating deals, and closing sales
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of market trends, industries, and service domain expertise
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team environment
  • Results-driven mindset with a focus on achieving and exceeding targets

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA

$120,000—$140,000 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CCPA DISCLOSURE

Unison is a telecom and renewables infrastructure investment firm funded in partnership with Ardian - the global investment house based in Paris with over $150 billion in assets under management. Unison commenced operations in 2003 and today invests in real estate and infrastructure hosting wireless and renewables tenants in the United States and Europe. The Company is expanding rapidly and looking for talented, entrepreneurial team members to grow with us.

THE TEAM:

The Unison team is looking for an energetic, thorough caller to be the first point of contact for a pipeline of real estate investment leads. Reporting to the Director of Lead Generation, the Caller / Scheduler is responsible for helping grow the company by setting appointments for the Account Managers with real estate property owners to assist in developing a robust sales pipeline.

THE JOB:

Manage personal pipeline of origination leads to set calls between site owners and Account Managers.

Achieve personal monthly, quarterly, and annual targets related to call settings and closings.

Rigorously monitor personal origination waterfall activity to ensure health and stability of sales pipeline.

Contribute user-experience input to origination processes such as data mining, CRM design, and marketing initiatives.

Contribute to strategic initiatives and product design to maintain a competitive market position.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Prior experience in a call-center sales environment.

Natural ability to build rapport.

Familiarity with finance concepts such as IRR and NPV required.

Familiarity with real estate closing process is a plus.

Experience originating within commercial real estate, mortgages, telecom, mineral rights acquisition, or renewables industries is a plus.

Some college or equivalent experience required.

MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES:

The successful candidate will bring a high level of ethical, intellectual, professional, and personal values that complement the team and company culture, including:

Entrepreneurial and collaborative team spirit.

Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

Proven ability to deliver results and prioritize tasks in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

Outstanding negotiation and influence skills.

Respect for colleagues and sense of humor.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Fieldguide

Fieldguide is the AI platform for audit and advisory firms. We are helping firms make the most consequential decision of the decade: not which AI tool to buy, but which partner to build their agentic firm with. Practitioner led, agent executed. We are Series C, scaling fast, and the firms we work with are rebuilding how professional services gets done.

The role

We are looking for a demand generation manager who thinks in funnels, not channels.

You will own Fieldguide’s campaign demand engine: the webinars, nurture tracks, email programs, and content distribution that build pipeline across every segment of the market. You will own the number for those channels, from the hypothesis to the honest read on what worked.

This is a hands-on program owner seat with real ownership. You will set the calendar, write the briefs, run the pods, and carry the outcome. You will work alongside a peer who owns paid performance, so you can go deep on the campaign side rather than spreading thin across everything.

You are also someone who uses AI daily. Not as a novelty, but because you have built workflows that let you produce like a team of three.

What you’ll do

Own the webinar program. Thought leadership, product release, and sponsored webinars. Content, production, promotion, registration and attendance conversion, and follow-up. Build it as a repeatable operating rhythm, not a series of one-offs.

Own nurture and lifecycle. Design and ship segmented nurture tracks by practice area, persona, and funnel stage. Instrument conversion before launch. Read it honestly. Kill what isn’t working.

Own email campaigns. Content launches, product announcements, pre and post event promotion. Every send has a hypothesis and a metric.

Own content syndication, distribution and segmentation. Take the content our brand and product marketing teams produce and get it in front of the right audience, in the right sequence, more than once. Define the audiences and the list strategy.

Orchestrate with ABM. Partner closely with our ABM lead so account-based plays have campaign air cover, a shared calendar, and the collateral they need.

Partner on the demand side of events. Catalyst, trade shows, and field events. You drive the demand campaign wrapped around the event: promotion, registration, and follow-up sequencing, alongside our Field Marketing team who own the event itself.

Report on what’s working. Own the campaign read in the weekly pipeline review: pipeline created and influenced by program, against pace. Build the reporting and the AI-assisted monitoring that surfaces a problem before anyone has to ask.

Use AI to multiply output. Ask whether AI can do the first 80% of every task, then spend your time on the judgment and the finish. Build agentic monitoring for campaign performance. Share the workflows so the leverage compounds across the team.

What you bring

  • 6+ years in B2B demand generation, campaign marketing, or lifecycle marketing, with clear ownership of a pipeline number.

  • Experience at the scale we are operating at: programs contributing meaningfully to a quarterly pipeline target in the eight figures, not a few hundred thousand.

  • Full-funnel thinking. You can walk through a program you owned and name the stages, the conversion rate at each one, the persona map, and where the leak was. Tactics are steps in a journey, never the whole story.

  • Deep hands-on experience with webinars, nurture, and email at real scale. You have this down to a science, not in theory.

  • Fluency in HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform. You build the workflow yourself; you don’t wait for ops.

  • A specific, demonstrable AI practice in campaign execution. You can show us the workflow, the inputs, and what it replaced.

  • Comfort in the seams. Much of this job is making the next function’s work easier: ABM, content, ops, sales. You bring dependencies in early and hand off cleanly.

  • A high bar you hold yourself. You are the first quality check on your own work, and you measure it against the best in the category, not against your last campaign.

  • B2B experience. Professional services, accounting, audit, or fintech is a plus; B2C is not a fit.

What great looks like here

We measure ourselves by outcomes, not effort. Great work doesn’t meet the standard, it sets it. Ordinary is the failure mode, even when ordinary is clean and correct.

If that sounds like the way you already work, we should talk.

About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by augmenting the work of assurance and audit practitioners with AI agents. The value we bring firms: Expertise, amplified. We are based in San Francisco and have raised over $125M+ in venture funding from top Silicon Valley investors to accomplish our ambitious vision, including Goldman Sachs, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We are the leading transformation partner for agentic audit and advisory with more than 50% of the top 100 CPA firms as customers, including several Big 4, and an industry-leading NPS to match. We save up to 75% of time on manual tasks and unlock over 4x capacity for audit practitioners, helping provide the work-life balance that is rare in the profession. Fieldguide is on the same growth curve as the later-stage vertical AI leaders, but you would be joining early enough to have a meaningful impact.

Fieldguide values diversity, both in backgrounds and in experiences to help build the future of audit and advisory. We are deliberate in preserving a winning culture with our FFLOWI values - Fearless, Fast, Lovable, Owners, Win-Win, Inclusive - providing space for teammates to do their career’s best work through a tightly knit support network.

If you want to shape the most important shift in how commerce and capital markets establish trust, alongside world-class teammates, Fieldguide would love to build with you.

About the Role

We're hiring a Social Media and Content Manager to join the Fieldguide team. You'll set the social strategy and own the content calendar that brings it to life, taking our product releases, thought leadership, and customer stories and rebuilding them into short form and serialized content, built to earn attention on a feed, while shaping how our biggest company moments show up on social from concept through execution. You'll partner closely with our product and marketing teams to determine how and where we show up to the industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Set social strategy and own execution, from concept through the content calendar that carries them.

  • Repurpose and reconstruct long-form assets (blog posts, eGuides, research reports, webinars) into social-native formats.

  • Write and manage recurring short form content for subject-matter experts and functional leads — byline series, resource articles, and campaign-driven event and demand-gen copy.

  • Own and evolve the team's content systems: calendar, briefing templates, and social brand guidelines, as the function scales.

  • Work directly with demand gen, product, and the broader content and communications team to scope campaigns and content from concept through final delivery.

Who You Are

  • Deep, hands-on social experience — you've personally run organic social strategy and execution for a brand: running the calendar, managing stakeholders, setting the cadence, and making platform-specific judgment calls.

  • A knack for translating complex subject matter — you can take dense, technical, or dry material and repurpose it into scroll-stopping content for native social formats

  • An instinct for visual storytelling — you know how to pair copy with the right format (carousel, short video, graphic) without waiting on a designer for every post.

  • Innately curious —A team player who's comfortable being edited and iterating, and brings genuine curiosity about how audit and advisory professionals engage online.

More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

  • Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

  • Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

  • Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

  • Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

  • Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

  • Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, vision, dental), plus life and disability insurance

  • Equity stock options

  • Paid public holidays, flexible PTO and flexible work schedules

  • 401(k) plan through Human Interest

  • Wellness benefits

  • Technology and work from home reimbursement

  • Paid parental leave

This role will require working closely with the top CPA firms in the U.S., where you will navigate a complex, multithreaded sales motion that spans executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.

  • Experience working for and/or selling directly to audit, advisory, or assurance firms is strongly preferred.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and drive large, complex deals across the finish line.

  • Capacity to engage deeply and broadly across an account—executives, practitioners, and technical teams—to influence stakeholders and drive meaningful change.

  • Able to manage complex, multithreaded sales processes involving customer stakeholders from executives to day-to-day product users.

  • Experience independently managing a complete sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation to close.

  • Team player who collaborates effectively across internal teams (Solutions, BDRs, Finance, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, etc.).

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are:

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.

Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high-performance, Made in America production.

About the team:

Formic's Marketing Team is the growth engine behind our commercial expansion. We move fast, experiment boldly, and build systems that scale. We work in close lockstep with Sales, RevOps, and Leadership to generate pipeline, sharpen our message, and get in front of the right manufacturers at the right time. This team is small, high-impact, and driven - and we're looking for someone who can match that energy.

About this role:

As our Head of Marketing, you will build, optimize, and lead a scalable engine for creating demand and qualified pipeline. You will own how Formic shows up in the market, how we identify and reach the manufacturers we can help, and how we turn that engagement into high quality opportunities for Sales.

This is a broad, hands-on role spanning Marketing, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering and managing a team to deliver across those areas. You'll bring those capabilities together around a common goal: creating qualified pipeline and quantifying through data and insights what's driving it. As Formic grows, you'll help determine how the team and these capabilities evolve.

We're looking for someone who combines creativity with operating rigor. You'll set strategy, but you'll stay close enough to the work to understand what's actually happening. You'll establish clear priorities, ownership, and metrics, and make decisions based on results. When something works, you'll scale it. When it doesn't, you'll change it or stop doing it.

You'll also build and develop the team around you. That means setting clear expectations, delegating real ownership, coaching people to get better, and holding the team accountable for results. We want a leader who welcomes challenges, seeks out evidence that their assumptions may be wrong, and changes course when the data or the team tells them something different.

This is a builder role. One day you might be sharpening Formic's positioning; the next, reviewing pipeline performance with Sales, coaching an SDR, digging into why a campaign isn't converting, or working with a GTM Engineer to test a completely different way of reaching manufacturers. You should be equally comfortable asking "What should we try?" and "Did it work?"

We’re not looking for a standard B2B marketing playbook or activity for activity’s sake. We’re looking for a Head of Marketing who creates focus from ambiguity, turns experiments into learning, and builds repeatable systems that drive measurable business results.

You’ll bring a healthy appetite for the unconventional—challenging how things have always been done, proposing bold ideas, and testing them intelligently. We want the kind of imagination that makes people stop, pay attention, and think differently about industrial automation.

The next great idea in industrial marketing probably sounds a little crazy. Good. We want to hear it. Help us make industrial robotics impossible to ignore.

You will own the engine that feeds our sales and deployments.

In this role you will:

Own Brand & Marketing

  • Own Formic's marketing strategy and how we show up in the market.
  • Develop and continually sharpen our positioning, messaging, and story.
  • Translate Formic's technology, business model, and customer value proposition into messaging that resonates with manufacturers and their economic buyers.
  • Own content, creative, video, website, customer stories, events, campaigns, thought leadership, PR, product marketing, and other channels that build awareness and demand.
  • Develop differentiated messaging across industries, use cases, personas, and stages of the buying journey.
  • Demonstrated ability to conceive and execute original, unconventional marketing campaigns that break through industry norms, capture attention, and produce measurable business impact.
  • Turn customer outcomes, deployments, product capabilities, and what we're learning in the field into compelling content.
  • Build Formic's brand within manufacturing while ensuring our marketing investments support clear commercial objectives.

Own Demand & Pipeline Generation

  • Own the creation of qualified pipelines across Marketing, lead generation, SDR/outbound, ABM, events, paid, organic, partnerships, and emerging channels.
  • Establish clear pipeline goals and build repeatable systems to identify, engage, and qualify manufacturers that fit Formic's ideal customer profile, optimizing channel mix, conversion, and resources.
  • Lead and develop our Sales Development function, including targeting, prospecting strategy, messaging, sequencing, coaching, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish clear funnel definitions, ownership, lead routing, and follow-up processes to ensure every source of inbound and outbound interest is captured, acted upon, and effectively handed off to Sales.
  • Partner closely with Sales and RevOps on territory priorities, pipeline needs, lead quality, conversion, and feedback from the market.
  • Measure pipeline contribution, progression, conversion, and cost by source and channel, connecting marketing investments to closed-won revenue and informing where to invest, optimize, or stop.

Build Our GTM Innovation Capability

  • Lead our GTM Engineering capability, using AI, automation, data, enrichment, personalization, and emerging technologies to improve how we identify, reach, engage, and qualify potential customers.
  • Own the effectiveness and evolution of our marketing technology ecosystem, including CRM integrations, outbound platforms, lead routing, data quality, attribution, and reporting, in partnership with Sales and RevOps.
  • Build and optimize scalable systems for account identification, segmentation, prospecting, personalization, campaign execution, and lead management.
  • Evaluate existing tools and workflows, identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, integrate, consolidate, or eliminate work rather than defaulting to additional tools or headcount.
  • Drive disciplined experimentation across channels, technologies, data sources, and approaches, establishing clear hypotheses, measurable outcomes, and decisions about what to scale, change, or stop.
  • Ensure our GTM infrastructure is reliable, documented, and maintainable, with clear ownership, appropriate data governance, and minimal dependency on any single person or external partner.

Own the Funnel and the Numbers

  • Establish clear visibility into the entire funnel, from target account through qualified opportunity, pipeline progression, and revenue.
  • Define and own a focused set of metrics that measure pipeline creation, conversion, velocity, cost, channel effectiveness, and commercial impact.
  • Partner with Sales and RevOps to ensure reliable data, consistent reporting, and a shared understanding of performance.
  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence that translates performance insights into decisions about strategy, priorities, budget, and resources, holding the organization accountable for outcomes rather than activity.

Create Focus and Accountability

  • Translate broad company objectives into clear priorities, ownership, expectations, and measurable outcomes that connect the team's work to business goals.
  • Make disciplined decisions about priorities and resources, challenging assumptions, stopping initiatives that aren't delivering results, and adapting as we learn.
  • Stay close enough to the work to identify problems early, remove obstacles, and hold people accountable without becoming a bottleneck to execution.
  • Foster a culture of transparency, constructive challenge, and open communication about performance, priorities, tradeoffs, and lessons learned.
  • Establish accountability for external agencies, contractors, and technology partners, including deliverables, performance, costs, documentation, and continuity, while building sustainable processes that preserve institutional knowledge and support organizational change.

Build and Lead the Team

  • Lead and align af multidisciplinary organization spanning Marketing, content and creative, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering around shared commercial goals.
  • Build a high-performing team by establishing clear expectations, delegating meaningful ownership, coaching and developing talent, and addressing performance gaps directly.
  • Assess existing capabilities, recognize and develop the strengths of the people already here, and determine what additional skills and resources we'll need as we grow.
  • Hire thoughtfully and build organizational capabilities that create leverage, rather than adding unnecessary layers or headcount.
  • Foster a culture of creativity, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement, where people feel empowered to challenge assumptions and solve problems.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience building and leading Marketing, Growth, Demand Generation, or similarly broad functions in high-growth B2B companies, with measurable commercial results.
  • A track record of building, improving, and scaling marketing and pipeline-generation systems, not simply inheriting and managing established operations.
  • Deep understanding of B2B demand generation, funnel economics, segmentation, conversion, attribution, and how Marketing, SDR, and Sales work together to create and convert pipeline.
  • Experience developing differentiated positioning and messaging for complex products, markets, and buying decisions.
  • Strong technical fluency and demonstrated experience evaluating, integrating, and optimizing marketing technology, data, automation, and AI-enabled GTM systems, with the ability to diagnose problems and make informed architectural decisions.
  • An AI-native mindset, with demonstrated ability to apply emerging technologies, experiment rigorously, evaluate results, and turn successful approaches into scalable capabilities.
  • Strong people leadership, including building and developing teams, delegating meaningful ownership, addressing performance gaps, and leading effectively through growth and organizational change.
  • An operating style that combines creativity, analytical rigor, intellectual flexibility, and accountability, with the judgment to challenge assumptions, make difficult tradeoffs, and change course when evidence warrants it.
  • The ability to operate strategically and tactically, creating clarity from ambiguity, communicating effectively across functions, and staying close enough to execution to understand and solve problems.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, robotics, industrial technology, or similarly complex B2B markets with long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.
  • Experience directly building or leading SDR organizations, including account-based and territory-based outbound strategies.
  • Experience building or leading GTM Engineering, Growth Engineering, or similar technical growth capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, Formic has a marketing and pipeline-generation engine that we understand, measure, and know how to scale.

We know who we should target, how to reach them, which messages resonate, which channels create qualified opportunities, what those opportunities cost, and where we should invest next.

There is clear ownership across the funnel. Marketing, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering operate as one connected organization, with a tight feedback loop into Sales. The team knows what matters and what it's accountable for.

Experiments have hypotheses and measurable outcomes. Successful ideas become repeatable systems. Unsuccessful ones produce learning and stop consuming resources. Decisions about priorities, budget, and headcount are grounded in results.

Our marketing and GTM infrastructure is reliable, integrated, and well understood. We have confidence in our data, clear accountability for lead management, and systems that the team can operate and improve independently. Technology and vendor decisions are deliberate, economically justified, and aligned with our commercial priorities.

Most importantly, Sales has a consistent and growing flow of qualified opportunities, and we can explain what is creating them.

That's the engine you'll own.

Our Total Rewards:

At Formic, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits and perks package for full-time, U.S.-based team members, including:

  • Equity in Formic: Participate in our stock option program and share in the success of a fast-growing start-up backed by leading global investors
  • Competitive & Uncapped Commission Structure: Designed to reward performance and impact in commission-eligible roles
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield and Unum, with 99% of employee premiums covered and 75% coverage for dependents, with optional buy-up plans available
  • Additional Insurance Benefits: FSA and DCFSA, life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability through Unum, all 100% employer-paid
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Fully funded by Formic, offering support when you need it most
  • Paid Parental Leave Program: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Company-sponsored 401(k): Invest in your future with our company-facilitated retirement savings plan
  • Home Office Stipend: A one-time allowance for fully remote and hybrid employees to support an at-home or on-the-road work setup
  • Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement: Monthly stipend toward personal phone and internet expenses
  • Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need, when you need it, supported by our flexible PTO policy

Compensation Philosophy

Formic’s pay and equity packages are thoughtfully benchmarked against peer companies at a similar growth stage. Equity represents a meaningful part of our mutual investment: when Formic succeeds, so do you.

Final offers are customized based on experience, geographic location, market considerations, and a candidate’s preferred balance of cash and equity. Our goal is to attract and reward top talent who will have significant impact, and we are open to thoughtful discussions to align on the right structure.

Compensation Range:

$145,000—$220,000 USD

What we look for:

We’re building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you!

  • Fearless Optimism: You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren’t paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn’t yet exist.
  • Create the Magic: You absorb complexity so customers don’t have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value-added, and outcome-driven. You don’t say “not my job.” You make things work.
  • Today, Not Tomorrow: You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don’t confuse activity with results.
  • Seek Truth: You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You’re willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer.
  • Made of Rubber: You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit.
  • One Formic: You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit.

Equal Opportunity Employment:

Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person’s merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to careers@formic.co.

AI Use:

At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.jobDescription:
Mercury is one of the fastest-growing companies in fintech, and we’re building something unusual in the category: a premium brand that people genuinely want to engage with.

We’re looking for a Head of Social & Community to shape how Mercury shows up in the world and deepen our relationship with the founders, entrepreneurs, and businesses we serve. You’ll lead our work across social, community, creators and influencers, and merch — bringing these channels together to build a brand people want to participate in, not just hear from.

This is a role for someone who wants to push beyond the standard brand playbook. You’ll have the opportunity to develop campaigns, partnerships, experiences, and ideas that most financial brands wouldn’t attempt, while growing and fostering one of the most engaged customer communities in fintech. You’ll report to our Head of Brand, lead a small but mighty team, and have the opportunity to expand as the function scales.

*Mercury is a financial technology company, not a FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group, Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Set the strategy for social and community at Mercury, connecting social, creators and influencers, and merch into a cohesive ecosystem that grows our audience, deepens engagement, and builds long-term brand affinity.
  • Shape and amplify Mercury’s voice across channels, setting a high bar for the ideas, writing, creative, and experiences we put into the world.
  • Develop breakthrough campaigns and programs that give people a reason to talk about, participate in, and advocate for Mercury - from an unexpected social idea to a creator partnership or piece of merch.
  • Connect our community work to the broader marketing organization, partnering closely with Brand, Creative, Growth, Product Marketing, Support, and others to turn company priorities into bigger ideas and bring insights from our community back into Mercury.
  • Own the goals, budgets, measurement, and operating rhythms for the function, balancing creative ambition with analytical rigor to understand what’s working and where to invest next.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of three, creating clarity across distinct areas of work and growing the organization as our ambitions expand.

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience leading a team and meaningful budget across social, merch, creator or influencer partnerships, or related brand and community disciplines.
  • Exceptional creative and editorial taste. You can write a great post, spot when a concept isn’t working, give incisive feedback on creative, and maintain a high bar without becoming a bottleneck.
  • A systems mindset. You know how to connect channels and individual moments to a larger story, building programs that compound into brand equity rather than a collection of one-offs.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to be connective tissue across teams, bringing together different priorities while keeping the customer and community at the center.
  • A bias toward ideas that break through. You’re curious about culture and the internet, challenge the standard playbook, and look for unexpected concepts, formats, and partnerships that make Mercury feel unlike other financial brands.
  • Strong people leadership and the ability to hire, coach, and develop people across different disciplines while moving comfortably between strategic thinking and the details of the work.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.jobDescription:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.

We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive — US to accelerate Sonatype's growth across one of the most commercially significant and competitive enterprise technology markets in North America.

This is a pure new-logo acquisition role for an accomplished enterprise hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, displacing established competitors and winning complex, high-value enterprise business.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The US West territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects across the United States, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.

Our role in detail:

Territory Development & Strategic New-Logo Acquisition:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise territory strategy across an assigned portfolio of US accounts.

  • Take full accountability for new-logo acquisition, building and converting a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.

  • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

  • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

  • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

  • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

  • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

    • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

    Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

    We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

    You will be expected to:

    • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

    • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

    • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

    • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

    • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

    • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

    • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

    • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

    • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

      • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

      Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

      This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

      You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

      You will:

      • Understand the commercial and technical challenges associated with open source software, software composition analysis, DevSecOps and application security.

      • Engage confidently with technical and executive buyers around software supply chain risk, developer productivity, governance and security.

      • Position Sonatype's platform capabilities across Nexus Repository, Firewall, Lifecycle and related solutions.

      • Understand how software supply chain intelligence can help organisations identify vulnerable components, prevent malicious packages entering development and make better risk decisions.

      • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led selling.

      • Recognise opportunities to position Sonatype as a strategic enterprise platform rather than a standalone point solution.

      • Stay informed about emerging technology, AI-assisted development, competitive market movements and evolving enterprise security requirements.

        • Channel & Cross-Functional Enterprise Selling:

        Enterprise sales success requires the ability to bring the right expertise together around the customer.

        You will:

        • Build productive relationships with regional channel partners, systems integrators and enterprise solution providers.

        • Identify partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities that support new-logo acquisition.

        • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop effective technical validation strategies and proofs of value.

        • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns, executive engagement and targeted enterprise outreach.

        • Engage executive sponsors where appropriate to support strategic opportunities.

        • Coordinate internal resources effectively while retaining clear ownership of the commercial outcome.

        • Share competitive intelligence, customer insights and market feedback to improve Sonatype's broader enterprise go-to-market execution.

          • Role Outcomes:

          Success in this role means establishing a high-performing, predictable new-logo acquisition engine across the assigned US West territory.

          You will be expected to:

          • Deliver against an annual new-business quota.

          • Consistently originate and close new enterprise customer opportunities.

          • Build a sustainable, self-generated enterprise pipeline.

          • Win strategically important competitive displacement opportunities.

          • Establish relationships with senior technology and security decision-makers across priority accounts.

          • Increase Sonatype's presence within major enterprise organisations.

          • Demonstrate strong enterprise deal qualification, commercial judgement and forecast accuracy.

          • Build effective relationships with Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel partners.

          • Create repeatable territory development and enterprise acquisition practices that support long-term growth.

            • What Success Looks Like:

            First 30 Days — Understand, Assess & Prioritise

            You will develop a deep understanding of Sonatype's technology, competitive positioning, customer value proposition and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

            You will assess your assigned territory, identify priority accounts, evaluate competitive incumbents and develop relationships with the wider Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel teams.

            You will begin building an evidence-based view of where the strongest new-logo opportunities exist.

            First 60 Days — Build the Acquisition Strategy

            You will have developed a prioritised territory plan, identifying target accounts, executive stakeholders, competitive displacement opportunities and clear outbound engagement strategies.

            You will be actively building relationships with prospective customers, generating qualified pipeline and coordinating account-based activity with the wider go-to-market organisation.

            Your opportunities will reflect clear customer challenges, credible buying processes and measurable business value.

            First 90 Days — Demonstrate Commercial Momentum

            You will be independently driving enterprise pursuits, demonstrating meaningful self-generated pipeline creation and establishing relationships with key decision-makers.

            You will be progressing opportunities through technical validation, commercial discovery and structured enterprise qualification.

            Your territory plan, pipeline coverage and forecasting will provide leadership with confidence in your approach to delivering against quota.

            First 12 Months — Deliver High Performance

            You will have established a sustainable enterprise acquisition engine and demonstrated the ability to deliver against a quota circa $1.5-2m.

            You will have acquired new enterprise customers, progressed competitive displacement opportunities and built a strong forward-looking pipeline.

            You will be recognised for your commercial judgement, proactive hunting mentality, enterprise customer credibility and ability to win complex opportunities.

            Who You Are:

            You are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with a demonstrable track record of acquiring new customers, exceeding ambitious revenue targets and winning in highly competitive markets.

            You are a hunter by nature, motivated by opening doors, creating opportunities and winning business that would otherwise remain with a competitor.

            Essential Experience & Capabilities

            Proven Enterprise New-Business Performance

            • Demonstrated success carrying and achieving substantial enterprise new-business quotas, ideally around $2 million annually or at a comparable level of commercial complexity.

            • A track record of consistent quota attainment and strong new-logo acquisition.

            • Evidence of personally originating, developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

            • Ability to quantify pipeline creation, average contract values, competitive wins and revenue performance.

              • Consistent High Performance

              • A history of operating among the strongest performers within your sales organisation.

              • President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition is particularly attractive.

              • Evidence of sustained performance across multiple sales periods, rather than reliance on one exceptional transaction or favourable territory.

                • Competitive Enterprise Selling

                • Proven experience winning business against established technology providers.

                • Ability to develop differentiated competitive strategies and challenge incumbent solutions.

                • Strong negotiation, executive engagement and commercial deal leadership skills.

                  • Enterprise Territory Development

                  • Experience developing a geographic or named-account territory through proactive outbound activity.

                  • Strong account prioritisation, stakeholder mapping and territory planning.

                  • Ability to generate your own pipeline rather than relying predominantly on inbound demand.

                    • Technical & Industry Understanding

                    • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or adjacent enterprise technology.

                    • Confidence engaging technical and executive stakeholders in complex buying environments.

                    • Ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial value.

                      • Sales Methodology & Commercial Discipline

                      • Experience applying structured enterprise qualification methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

                      • Strong forecasting, opportunity management and pipeline discipline.

                      • Ability to manage complex enterprise opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations and procurement processes.

                        • Preferred Experience:

                        We would particularly welcome candidates with experience from:

                        • Software supply chain security and software composition analysis.

                        • Application security and DevSecOps platforms.

                        • Repository management and developer infrastructure.

                        • Enterprise cybersecurity and cloud-native security.

                        • Enterprise platform selling and competitive displacement.

                        • Global 2000, Fortune 500 or similarly complex enterprise customers.

                        • Working with channel partners and enterprise systems integrators.

                        • Selling across the US West technology and enterprise ecosystem.

                        • Consumption-based, platform-led or land-and-expand commercial models.

Compensation

Additional Information

Things that we are proud of

  • 2025 AI Compliance Solution of the Year - AI Breakthrough Awards

  • 2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology

  • 2024 Industry Leader in Forrester-Wave for Software Composition Analysis (2024 Q4 report)

  • 2023 Fast Company Best Places for Innovators

  • 2023 Gartner’s Magic Quadrant

  • 2023 Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies

  • 2023 BuiltIn Best Places to Work

  • 2022 Frost & Sullivan Technology Innovation Leader Award

  • 2022 PeerSpot Silver Peer Award in Software Composition Analysis

  • 2022 Tech Ascension Best DevOps Security Solution Award

  • 2022 NVCT Cyber Company of the Year

jobs.jobDescription:
Mercury is one of the fastest growing companies in fintech, and one of the few that wants to be a premium consumer-facing brand. We’re seeking the right person to shape and deliver our brand team’s investment strategy and media approach—with huge financial and career upside as the company continues to grow.

In this role, you will report to our Head of Brand and be responsible for amplifying our launches and company narrative across paid channels, with oversight on agency relationships, key partners, and measurement. This is an opportunity to build a unique and differentiated approach for a brand that’s unafraid to think differently and challenge competitors.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

  • Own Mercury's media investment strategy — build and execute the plan for a budget doubling year over year, deciding where, when, and how we invest across channels to deliver near-term results while building an approach that scales with the spend.
  • Differentiate how Mercury shows up in market — develop a media and distribution approach that stands apart from the standard playbook and lets us outmaneuver competitors who outspend us, through unconventional channels, formats, partnerships, and creative use of the media we buy.
  • Lead our agency and media partners — set the agenda, hold a high bar on their work, and source, evaluate, and onboard new partners as our needs evolve.
  • Build the measurement system — establish a rigorous framework for attribution, incrementality, and optimization that can support spend at the magnitude we aspire to, and leverage learnings to drive our investment decisions.
  • Connect media to the broader marketing ecosystem — integrate paid media with brand, performance, community, content, lifecycle, and product marketing so that media amplifies what the rest of the team creates rather than running in parallel to it.

You should:

  • Have deep media expertise — 15+ years building and running a media investment strategy on a fast-growing budget, with a proven track record delivering and measuring short-term wins while putting systems in place that last.
  • Be a market leader, not a best-practices follower — you find the unique, high-impact approach others haven't thought of, and you have examples of media work that was recognized as differentiated
  • Think in systems — you see media as one part of a larger marketing engine and design programs that make everything else Mercury does travel further and more efficiently.
  • Be rigorous about measurement — you're fluent in attribution, incrementality testing, and media mix modeling, and you can turn that analysis into confident decisions and a clear story for leadership.
  • Have a track record of agency management — you've managed agencies and vendors and you know how to assess their work and hold them accountable

jobs.jobDescription:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:

  • Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area
  • Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans
  • Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers
  • Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis
  • Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs
  • Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact
  • Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery

What we are looking for in you

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English
  • Exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source
  • Strong track record shaping go-to-market strategy, messaging, and campaigns that move the pipeline
  • Fast adaptation to change and new technology adoption in marketing
  • A leader, growing and elevating others across the organization
  • A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management
  • Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions
  • Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams
  • Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy
  • Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale

Nice-to-have skills

  • Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth
  • Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches
  • Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio
  • Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors
  • Understanding of open source communities and business models
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum

Annual compensation review

Recognition rewards

Annual holiday leave

Parental Leave

‍Employee Assistance Programme

Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Sr. Director, Enablement to join our Revenue team. This position will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and Enablement. The Revenue Operations and Enablement team is responsible for sales strategy, technology, and enablement. The Sr. Director, Enablement will build a repeatable enablement framework to systematically support all segments of LaunchDarkly’s Revenue Organization. This role will ensure that all customer-facing personnel have the knowledge, content, skills, processes, and behaviors needed to optimize every interaction with buyers. The role will also oversee the planning and execution of Revenue Organization events, including SKOs.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with leadership experience in a revenue-focused organization where enablement is integrated into every interaction. They bring deep experience developing enablement programs, supporting ongoing employee development, and implementing the processes and tools required to build a world-class enablement function.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the multi-year revenue enablement strategy and roadmap, aligned to GTM priorities, with quarterly outcomes tied to ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment.
  • Lead and grow a global team of enablement leaders and specialists, setting clear priorities, coaching for excellence, and operating as a player-coach where needed.

  • Own the enablement track for the annual GTM kickoff and quarterly business reviews, with full oversight of content and readiness.

  • Partner with the CRO, VP Sales, VP CS, Product, Product Marketing, and Partner leaders to align messaging, qualification frameworks, and customer journey execution, and advise GTM leadership on readiness and change management for new initiatives.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that link enablement to GTM outcomes (rep, PAM, and SDR productivity, internal satisfaction, completion), using data to prioritize investment and retire programs that don't move the number.
  • Define and drive the partner enablement strategy, aligned with internal enablement programs and GTM motions.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years combined in sales and sales enablement at enterprise SaaS companies, including 5+ years in leadership.
  • Track record of scaling onboarding and enablement in a high-growth environment.
  • Deep expertise in core enablement disciplines: value selling, sales process and methodologies, coaching, skill development, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and Product to build a culture of alignment.
  • History of designing and launching partner enablement programs.
  • Skilled at creating learning content and shaping a unified communications strategy that keeps the field informed and aligned.
  • Prior work in a GTM strategy role, with a strong grasp of how enablement connects to revenue planning.
  • Success planning and executing large-scale events, such as global sales kickoffs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence at every level, including executive leadership.
  • Nice to have:
    • Time spent carrying a quota in a selling role.
    • Leadership of a sales-related function, such as Sales Development, Inside Sales, or Enterprise Sales.
    • Familiarity with enterprise technology companies serving the developer space.
    • Hands-on work developing competitive programs, buyer personas, and customer reference programs.

What our Clients' Service Executives do every day is quite influential and consequential. Great Agency work starts and ends with us. Who you are:

The Account Executive supports client services efforts in a critical way, connecting the activities of the agency to clients. The Account Executive is responsible for implementing projects to promote and support the success and profitability of client deliverables. In implementing projects, the Account Executive drives the daily tasks of by communicating with key internal service delivery personnel and leading client communications.

This role is the ideal fit for someone who is media-fluent but fundamentally a strong account team member. Comfort with understanding pacing and performance, navigating optimizations and delivery issues, and coordinating effectively across media strategy, search, programmatic, social, analytics, creative and other agency partners are key elements of the role. Pharma experience across HCP and/or DTC would be highly valuable.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Tactical Management

  • Demonstrates sound judgement and operates with an appropriate sense of urgency
  • Manages the workflow of all assigned accounts to ensure jobs are on track and completed accurately
  • Develops and maintains account status reports and collaborates with project managers on creation and maintenance of project timelines
  • Contributes to project briefs (background, job specs, dates)
  • Updates client and team on activity schedules and next steps
  • Owns deck for meetings (and associated technology)
  • Reviews all materials for accuracy and completion prior to client delivery, presentation, or final production
  • Submits requests for direct cost estimates; obtains client approval of all cost estimates
  • Maintains organized job files of project materials

Client Management

  • Applies understanding about client’s line of business (e.g., target customers, products) in discussions with client and internal team
  • May serve as client’s day-to-day liaison, providing timely status and information on client’s projects
  • Establishes and fosters relationships day-to-day with clients
  • Works consultatively with team lead to balance agency and client needs and push back when/where appropriate
  • Runs status calls and other select calls/meetings
  • Keeps supervisor apprised of client activities and problems

Financial Management

  • Assists in estimating agency fees for client proposals
  • Assists in preparation of job budgets, obtaining internal budget approvals, and allocating hours to team members
  • Maintains accurate records of client expenditures, time utilization, and billing information
  • Assists with managing client’s budget tracker(s) and with preparation of realistic billing forecasts
  • Helps move work effectively through the shop in order to meet agency profitability goals
  • Identifies and brings management’s attention to bottlenecks or other issues that may jeopardize profitability by project

Product Knowledge

  • Develops understanding of product category and competitors, as well as key data sets
  • Strategy
  • Remains focused on details, but takes initiative in building understanding of bigger picture of clients’ objectives and initiatives including target patient/professional audiences; key milestones (clinical trial initiation, completion of FDA panel review, NDA submission, launch, etc.); competitive landscape, clinical background, key client performance metrics (sales goals, scripts, etc.)
  • Business Development
  • Identifies opportunities to grow in-line client business and billings and enlists support of senior team/ management to follow up on these opportunities appropriately

Required:

  • At least one year of experience as an Assistant Account Executive or Account Executive within an advertising, marketing, communication or related industry

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with clients’ online submission systems for medical/regulatory and legal reviews (e.g., Zinc or Veeva)

  • Experience in writing SOWs and project briefs

Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

Why this role is so important

Sonatype is a fast-growing software company helping companies manage their open-source software supply chains. As a subscription-based business, our success hinges on our ability to renew and expand existing customer accounts. Fortunately, our customers trust Sonatype and value our solutions. This trust is demonstrated by our 90%+ renewal rate -- one of the highest renewal rates in the software subscription industry. As we grow, we must maintain and even increase this rate.

About the Position

We are looking for a passionate, reliable, and highly competent Renewal Specialist. This position may be appealing if you’re early in your career, are a contracts/accounting specialist looking for a change, or are looking for a path to a customer-facing career.

You will be accountable for proactively working through to on-time completion of renewing software subscriptions. You will monitor contract renewal terms and engage with customers to determine the best approach to retaining and even expanding the Sonatype footprint. And since there can be hiccups along the way, you will need to tap into your seasoned judgment in non-routine renewal situations to ensure customer success while maintaining subscription integrity and profitability.

What You will do

  • Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Accounting to efficiently close a set of renewals and related expansions
  • Review customer renewal information, usage data, and subscription history to ensure mutual agreement on the appropriate renewal options
  • Proactively identify future renewals, connecting with the customer well before the expiration date to ensure on-time execution of renewals.
  • Educate customers on relevant subscription options based on their current and future product and service goals
  • Coordinate the preparation of renewal quotes and ordering documents and ensuring their mutual execution and processing per Sonatype’s policies and procedures
  • Help ensure customers are SUCCESSFUL and DELIGHTED with Sonatype products and services, not merely satisfied.

What we are seeking

  • Experience in a high-volume activity environment, managing multiple priorities and competing demands while focusing on the primary goal.
  • Ability to discuss contract compliance, expansions, and product pricing with customers
  • Extreme attention to detail to ensure customers execute contract paperwork accurately and on-time
  • Experience with Salesforce.com or other CRM systems.
  • Ability to work odd hours and or additional hours supporting global customers during times of critical volumes
  • Interest in learning about modern software development and associated technologies
  • Strong preference for candidates located in EST or CST
