Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

As a Pre-Sales Solution Consultant, Big Tech/AI, you will partner with Sales to demonstrate how Socure can solve complex identity, fraud, risk, and compliance challenges for strategic technology and AI customers.

You will lead discovery, technical qualification, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concept initiatives, and executive presentations throughout the sales cycle. Your work will create customer confidence in Socure’s solution, establish a technically credible path to implementation, and support successful handoff to post-sales teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own pre-sales solution consulting for strategic Big Tech/AI customers from qualification through closed won.

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to understand customer priorities, business objectives, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

  • Lead discovery sessions that uncover customer challenges across identity, fraud, risk, onboarding, compliance, and operational workflows.

  • Design scalable solutions that align Socure’s platform capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations, technical workshops, architecture discussions, and executive presentations.

  • Lead or support proof-of-concept, proof-of-value, and data study design and execution in partnership with Data Science.

  • Define clear POC success criteria, assumptions, evaluation metrics, implementation considerations, and risks.

  • Translate complex technical, analytical, and statistical findings into clear recommendations for technical, business, and executive audiences.

  • Support RFPs, RFIs, security reviews, technical questionnaires, proposals, statements of work, and related sales deliverables.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, and Marketing to address customer requirements and deliver compelling solutions.

  • Build technical win strategies that establish credible solution fit, customer confidence, and a clear path to implementation.

  • Apply industry and domain expertise to tailor strategies for customers operating in identity, fraud, fintech, financial services, AI, data, and regulated environments.

  • Bring customer and field insights back to Product and Product Marketing to influence roadmap priorities, messaging, and future solution innovation.

  • Create reusable assets, frameworks, and playbooks that improve consistency and effectiveness across the Solution Consulting team.

  • Mentor teammates and contribute to a culture of technical excellence, customer focus, and continuous learning.

  • Partner with post-sales teams to ensure high-quality handoffs, including customer goals, proposed architecture, POC outcomes, assumptions, risks, and success criteria.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience in solutions consulting, sales engineering, professional services, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing role.

  • A proven track record leading enterprise sales engagements involving multiple stakeholders and complex technical or operational requirements.

  • Strong experience with discovery, solution design, technical demonstrations, architecture discussions, and proof-of-concept execution.

  • Technical depth across RESTful APIs, data flows, analytics, machine learning or data science-adjacent technologies, and modern software delivery environments.

  • Experience translating complex technical, analytical, or statistical concepts into clear business recommendations.

  • Familiarity with identity verification, fraud prevention, risk management, fintech, financial services, Big Tech, AI, or other data-intensive domains.

  • The ability to build credibility with both technical and executive audiences.

  • Strong presentation, communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Experience working with enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, APIs, data products, or technology integrations.

  • A customer-first mindset with strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

  • A commitment to continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and operational excellence.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

  • The direct measurability of digital media.
  • Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
  • The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

Job Category
We are seeking a seasoned industry professional to join our team as Senior Sales Executive, Health, Medicare & Life, focused on expanding our partnerships within the Life, Health, Medicare, and Property & Casualty insurance industries. This senior-level role will be dedicated to business development—owning the full advertiser sales cycle from prospecting through deal close—while helping define and execute the broader sales strategy in a fast-moving and competitive landscape.

The ideal candidate brings a deep network of insurance contacts, particularly in Life, Health, Medicare, Auto, and Home, Commercial, and has a proven track record of strategic deal-making, contract negotiation, and performance marketing. This is a high-impact role suited for a consultative seller with strong business acumen and a passion for building long-term partnerships.

  • Deliver best-in-class communication and support to partners, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor
  • Negotiate complex deals, manage contract redlines, and ensure a high-quality and timely execution process
  • Work closely with Account Management to ensure a smooth handoff and long-term client success
  • Partner with the Creative team to prepare compelling marketing and pitch decks
  • Provide market feedback and industry insights to internal teams to help shape our offerings
  • Travel up to 20–30% to attend industry events and meet with clients

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in business development or advertiser sales, with a focus on closing large strategic deals
  • Proven background and existing network in Life, Health, Medicare, or P&C Insurance is strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing models (e.g., clicks, leads, calls)

  • Skilled in consultative sales, identifying client pain points and delivering tailored solutions

  • Exceptional presentation, writing, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Proficient in Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint, and other relevant tools

jobs.jobDescription:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.

Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.

Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.

You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.

What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.

You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.

This is not a script-and-cadence BDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

What you will do?

  • Build coverage across AWS US sales territories: account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers (Data, AI/ML, Modernization).
  • Reach out, follow up, show up at AWS Summits and regional partner events, and build named relationships.
  • Walk AWS reps through what agent-native AWS modernization means in practice and why it's different from what every other partner in their deck says.
  • Anchor every conversation in shipped Mactores case studies: named customer, named baseline, named outcome, time-to-value, cost reduction.
  • Identify customer fit, frame the business problem, articulate Mactores' business value, and tee up the technical demo.
  • Hand off to the forward-deployed engineer for the architecture walkthrough. Your job is to make sure the FDE walks into a qualified room.
  • Source Amazon-originated opportunities into the Mactores pipeline, register them in ACE, and keep the AWS rep in the loop through cycle close.
  • Feed market signal back to Mactores leadership, what AWS reps hear from customers, where the partner conversation is shifting, and which messaging lands.

What are we looking for?

  • 3–5 years in a BDR, SDR, or partner-development role, with a demonstrated ability to source qualified pipeline from a cold start.
  • Comfort talking to AWS field teams. Prior work at an AWS partner, exposure to AWS Partner Central, ACE, or MAP, and time on the floor at AWS Summits or re:Invent are preferred, not required but they shorten the ramp.
  • Comfort with the technical concepts of cloud modernization, data platforms, and agentic AI without being the engineer in the room. You can read an architecture diagram, talk through a case study, and name where the customer's pain is. You don't need to debug a Lambda.
  • Sharp business-value articulation: you can take a messy customer problem statement, restate it in two sentences, and show how Mactores ships against it.
  • A self-managed work style. Remote role, distributed AWS field, no daily stand-up babysitting your activity.
  • Travel roughly 30% across the US AWS offices, customer sites, AWS Summits, re:Invent, and regional partner events.

How we work?

We're not selling a roadmap. Our agents run in production today, and our forward-deployed engineers ship with them every day. Mactores is MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and holds seven AWS Consulting Competencies and seventeen Service Validations, the credentials that make an AWS rep's routing decision easy.

The agent-native category window is 6–12 months. After that, "agent-native" becomes commodity vocabulary the way "cloud-native" did. We're on the early side of that window, and the BDR who plants the flag in AWS field conversations now will own those relationships when the category gets loud. You'll join an existing partnership and sales motion, the system works. Your job is to add territory coverage and AWS-originated pipeline to it, not invent the function from scratch.

How you'll be measured

A combination of net-new logos and AWS-originated revenue. Not call counts, not email volume, not meetings booked for their own sake. The leading indicator is qualified AWS-sourced pipeline. The lagging indicator is closed-won revenue from customers who came in through the AWS field. Quota structure and targets are discussed in the interview process.

Compensation

jobs.jobDescription:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Event & Field Marketing Manager – East / Central to join Cresta’s Revenue Marketing team. This role owns strategy, execution, and performance across a high-volume portfolio of field marketing programs — from industry events and executive dinners to regional programs, roadshows, customer experiences, and partner activations.

This isn’t an events-for-events-sake role. Field Marketing is a meaningful pipeline channel at Cresta, and you’ll partner closely with Sales to determine where we invest, which accounts and audiences we target, and how programs contribute to pipeline creation and acceleration.

You’ll typically own 8–10+ programs per quarter and be responsible for taking them from initial strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, measurement, and optimization.

Location: This is a remote role supporting our East region. We strongly prefer candidates currently based on the U.S. East Coast, but are open to candidates in the Central U.S. who can easily support Eastern time zones and regional travel. This role requires approximately 20–30% travel, with heavier travel during peak event seasons.

Responsibilities

  • Own Field Strategy + Execution: Build and execute field marketing programs aligned to regional Sales priorities, target accounts, and pipeline goals.
  • Drive Pipeline + ROI: Set program KPIs, track sourced and influenced pipeline, measure conversion and ROI, and translate results into clear recommendations.
  • Partner Closely with Sales: Work with Sales before, during, and after programs on account targeting, attendance, meetings, follow-up, and opportunity acceleration.
  • Manage a High-Volume Portfolio: Own 8–10+ programs per quarter across tradeshows, executive dinners, roadshows, customer programs, regional activations, and partner events.
  • Own Programs End-to-End: Manage strategy, budgets, vendors, contracts, promotion, attendee experience, onsite execution, and post-event reporting.
  • Make Smart Investment Decisions: Evaluate program performance, forecast spend, identify trade-offs, and shift investment toward the programs driving the strongest business impact.
  • Build Integrated Campaigns: Partner with Demand Gen, Digital, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales to drive attendance and engagement across target accounts.
  • Create Standout Experiences: Bring new ideas and formats to the table that differentiate Cresta and create meaningful experiences for customers and prospects.
  • Build Repeatable Playbooks: Develop processes and workflows that allow the field marketing motion to scale as Cresta grows.
  • Support Executive Programs: Partner with Cresta executives and Sales leaders on messaging, speaker preparation, executive experiences, and customer engagement.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of B2B field marketing, regional marketing, event marketing, or integrated campaign experience
  • Experience owning field programs end-to-end, from strategy through execution and measurement
  • Comfortable managing 8–10+ concurrent programs per quarter in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong understanding of pipeline, revenue attribution, conversion, and event ROI
  • Proven experience partnering directly with Sales on account targeting, program strategy, and follow-up
  • Experience managing program budgets, vendors, contracts, and competing priorities
  • Strong communicator who can work effectively across Sales, Marketing, executives, agencies, and external partners
  • Currently based in the Eastern or Central U.S., with a strong preference for East Coast
  • Willing and able to travel approximately 20–30%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or startup environment
  • Experience with AI, Contact Center, Customer Experience, or adjacent enterprise technology
  • Experience supporting enterprise or strategic Sales teams
  • Experience with ABM/account-based field marketing programs
  • Previous Sales/SDR experience or strong understanding of enterprise Sales processes
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and field marketing/event tools such as Mobly

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans designed to fit you and your family’s needs
  • Flexible vacation time to support a healthy work-life blend
  • Paid parental leave
  • Monthly gym and phone allowance
  • Work-from-home office stipend
  • Lunches and dinners for in-office employees via Grubhub

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors including experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base salary, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Salary Range: $110,000–$150,000 base + equity

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.jobDescription:
About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.

Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!

We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!

LastPass is looking for a Senior Demand Generation Manager, Tier Upgrade:

In this role, you will own the upsell motion that moves customers up our B2B SKU ladder — from Teams to Business to BusinessMax. Unlike seat growth, which is about adding more users, this role is about proving there's more value to unlock at the next tier, and building the account-based programs that get the right buying team to see it. You'll run a focused, ABM-style motion against a defined target account list, working hand-in-hand with Field Marketing, Events, and Sales to reach every relevant stakeholder in each account. If you know the difference between how mid-market and enterprise buying committees actually make decisions, and you like owning a named-account list rather than a broad funnel, this is the role for you.

About the team:

You'll join the Demand Generation team within a broader Marketing organization that also includes Field Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Campaign Operations, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Paid Media. Demand Gen managers each own a distinct, independently measurable slice of the funnel; this role owns SKU tier upgrade, working alongside peers who own new-customer acquisition and seat expansion. You'll partner especially closely with Field Marketing and Events to coordinate account-based reach, and with Analytics and Marketing Operations to keep target account data and segmentation current.

Who will you work with?

You will report to Demand Generation leadership and collaborate daily with Sales on target account prioritization and buying-team coverage. You'll also partner with Field Marketing and Events to coordinate multi-channel account reach, Analytics and Marketing Operations on segmentation and database strategy, and internal content and creative teams to close content gaps across the funnel.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Own the tier upgrade number — moving customers from Teams to Business to BusinessMax — against a defined target account list
  • Design and run multi-channel ABM campaigns tailored to mid-market accounts, with a clear point of view on how scaled ABM differs from traditional demand gen
  • Bring a sharp understanding of the differences between small business and mid-market buying dynamics, and adjust program design accordingly
  • Identify content gaps across target segments and funnel stages, and advocate for and orchestrate the development of that content with internal marketing producers
  • Use database segmentation to identify gaps in buying-team coverage and key personas within target accounts, and run programs to close them
  • Coordinate campaign deployment closely with the Field and Events teams to maximize reach and account coverage
  • Adapt targeting methods across multiple geographies, accounting for regulatory differences that affect how accounts and contacts can be reached
  • Measure programs against KPIs tied to tier upgrade pipeline and conversion, and continually refine account selection and messaging based on results

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Proven experience in B2B demand generation, with direct experience running ABM programs in mid-market segments
  • A clear, well-formed point of view on how scaled ABM operates, and where it differs from enterprise-style, high-touch ABM
  • Experience identifying content needs across segments and the funnel, and driving that content into production through internal marketing partners
  • Hands-on experience with database segmentation to uncover and close gaps in buying-team coverage and personas
  • A track record of close coordination with Field Marketing and Events to land multi-channel account-based campaigns
  • Experience running campaigns across multiple geographies, with an understanding of how targeting and outreach methods shift with local regulatory requirements
  • Strong analytical instincts — you partner with data rather than wait for it, and use it to prioritize accounts and refine targeting
  • Fluency with AI tools to support account research, content development, and campaign analysis

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

US Pay Range

$119,000—$140,000 USD

Why LastPass?

  • The leader in secure access
  • High-growth, collaborative environment with inclusive teams
  • Remote-first culture
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible Paid Time Off policies, including but not limited to: Quarterly Self-Care Days (4 extra paid days off annually) and Volunteer Days
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including dependents
  • Home office setup support
  • LastPass Families free account for up to 5 members
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including an annual learning stipend to invest in your growth
  • Peer-to-peer recognition through Quantum Workplace
  • Employee Assistance Program for well-being support
  • Remote work stipend to support your home office needs
  • Short-Term or Remote-Centric Work Arrangements for added flexibility

Unlock your potential with us - your skills, experience, and unique perspective matter more than just checking the boxes. Apply today, and let's build the future together!

We’re building an inclusive community that reflects the people of all races, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, backgrounds, and perspectives who share our world.

For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:

This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for driving strategic, multi-year growth across a defined set of large enterprise accounts. The Enterprise Account Executive operates as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, helping organizations protect critical systems, ensure cyber resilience, and modernize their data protection strategy using Veeam’s industry-leading platform.

Success in this role requires the ability to orchestrate complex enterprise pursuits, influence C-level stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in long sales cycles with high visibility and material business impact.

*Due to business need, candidates must reside in the specified region in order to be considered (Houston, TX area strongly preferred)

What you’ll do:

  • Consistently achieve and exceed annual enterprise sales targets through disciplined execution and strategic account planning
  • Establish Veeam as a mission-critical partner, not a point solution, within assigned enterprise accounts
  • Drive net-new adoption and platform expansion across complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Build and execute account-based strategies that align to customer business priorities, risk posture, and long-term transformation initiatives

Core Responsibilities:

Enterprise Sales Leadership

  • Own and lead end-to-end enterprise sales cycles, from executive discovery through close and expansion
  • Develop and execute multi-year territory and account strategies grounded in data, customer insight, and competitive intelligence
  • Lead complex negotiations by clearly articulating business value, ROI, and risk reduction, not just product capability

Executive Engagement

  • Engage CIOs, CISOs, VPs of IT, and other senior stakeholders in outcome-driven conversations
  • Identify and align to the economic buyer, technical buyer, and power base within each account
  • Position Veeam as a strategic partner in cyber resilience, operational continuity, and data protection modernization

Account & Pipeline Management

  • Build and maintain accurate, inspection-ready forecasts and pipeline coverage
  • Create and manage relationship maps and account plans that reflect both current access and aspirational targets
  • Identify whitespace, expansion paths, and competitive displacement opportunities

Cross-Functional Orchestration

  • Coordinate effectively with Systems Engineering, Channel Partners, Marketing, SDRs, Deal Desk, Legal, and Customer Success
  • Lead pursuit teams with clarity, urgency, and accountability
  • Serve as the customer’s advocate inside Veeam while representing Veeam’s standards and strategy externally

What you’ll bring:

  • Proven success selling large, complex enterprise solutions with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to win and expand strategic accounts, not just transact
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to challenge, reframe, and influence senior leaders
  • High level of business acumen with experience translating customer challenges into measurable outcomes
  • Track record of disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and territory execution
  • Experience working within a channel-centric enterprise sales model
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and account intelligence tools
  • High integrity, resilience, competitiveness, and personal accountability

#LI-KS2

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice, which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing.

jobs.jobDescription:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.

Location: This is a remote role in Americas timezones.

The role entails

  • Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
  • Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.jobDescription:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Public Sector team

  • Sierra recently received FedRAMP High certification and were awarded our first contract with a federal agency. We’re now building our founding public sector team to redefine the relationship between the government and its citizenry.

  • Today, our agents already enable citizens to access social services, report fraud, and understand complex government systems. Simultaneously, they empower government officials to better hear the concerns and inquiries of their constituencies.

  • We are explicitly nonpartisan and committed to empowering public servants to leverage AI to advance their important missions.

  • In our journey, we are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead Sierra’s public sector sales team: Recruit, develop, and lead a team of account executives serving strategic federal, state, or local government accounts. Set clear expectations, coach for performance, and build a culture of customer obsession, accountability, and consistent execution.

  • Own revenue growth and territory strategy: Translate Sierra’s public sector ambitions into territory coverage, account priorities, pipeline goals, and revenue plans. Allocate resources thoughtfully, maintain rigorous forecasts, and drive the team to consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets.

  • Create opportunities around mission outcomes: Build executive relationships with agency leaders and help your team translate priorities such as constituent access, service delivery, workforce effectiveness, and program integrity into compelling AI agent opportunities. Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic accounts.

  • Guide complex sales cycles from discovery through award: Coach account executives through long, multi-stakeholder government buying processes and engage directly at critical moments. Mobilize cross-functional support for executive alignment, solution development, business cases, security and legal reviews, pricing, proposal strategy, negotiation, and close.

  • Shape acquisition and capture strategy: Ensure every priority opportunity has a credible path to contract and a disciplined capture plan. Help the team navigate funding, fiscal-year timing, competitive dynamics, and procurement pathways—including GSA schedules, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, state schedules, and cooperative purchasing agreements. Lead deal reviews that surface risks early and turn strategy into clear next steps.

  • Scale Sierra’s partner ecosystem: Partner with public sector and partnerships leadership to build productive relationships with prime contractors, systems integrators, resellers, distributors, small-business partners, and technology providers. Guide decisions about direct sales, subcontracting, teaming, and partner-led transactions to expand customer access and accelerate growth.

  • Lead strategic prime and teaming relationships: Establish executive alignment with key partners and help shape account ownership, deal registration, workshare, and joint go-to-market plans. Ensure partnerships bring meaningful customer access, past performance, implementation capacity, or procurement pathways—and translate into qualified pipeline and successful delivery.

  • Drive disciplined pursuit and proposal decisions: Partner with the Public Sector GM on bid/no-bid recommendations and prioritize resources across strategic pursuits. Align sales, legal, security, product, engineering, and delivery teams to produce procurement responses that are compliant, differentiated, and precise.

  • Stay accountable for customer success: Build trust with senior agency leaders, establish strong handoffs from sales to delivery, and remain engaged through deployment and expansion. Help resolve escalations and ensure commitments made during the sales process support lasting customer relationships.

  • Build a repeatable public sector go-to-market motion: Work with public sector leadership to refine account segmentation, hiring and capacity plans, capture processes, partner strategy, contract-vehicle priorities, and sales playbooks. Bring market signals and customer feedback to product and company leadership to shape Sierra’s platform and public sector strategy.

  • Lead an AI-native sales organization: Embed AI into how the team researches accounts, develops outreach, synthesizes calls, plans opportunities, creates proposals, and forecasts. Model effective use, share successful practices, and help account executives spend more time on judgment, strategy, and customer relationships.

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years of selling experience: Extensive experience in enterprise customer-facing sales role, specifically selling to the U.S. government.

  • People leadership experience: 10+ years managing, mentoring, and developing a high-performing enterprise sales team.

  • Enterprise experience: You've run and managed end-to-end complex deals ($1M+).

  • Strong fluency in government acquisition and procurement, including funding and budget cycles, competitive solicitations, proposal processes, task orders, and common Federal or state contract vehicles.

  • Experience developing and executing capture strategies before a solicitation is released—not simply responding once an RFP is public.

  • A strong network and demonstrated ability to work with government technology partners, including prime contractors, systems integrators, resellers, distributors, and small-business teaming partners.

  • Sound judgment about direct, channel, prime/subcontractor, and teaming models, with the ability to select and execute the right path for a particular agency and opportunity.

  • The ability to build credibility with agency executives, program leaders, contracting and procurement officials, security teams, and technical stakeholders—and to align those groups around a shared path forward.

  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, account planning, and forecasting skills. You are rigorous about details, procurement milestones, and next steps.

  • A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of government institutions to improve outcomes for the people they serve.

  • Comfort operating with high ownership in an early-stage business: you create structure where it does not yet exist, move with urgency, and collaborate deeply across functions.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.

Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.

The role entails

  • Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
  • Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

Our agents handle everything from order tracking and account management to field service scheduling and billing support, tuned to the voice and workflows of each business.

jobs.jobDescription:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

The Client Partner, Real-World Evidence is responsible for driving growth with biopharma customers by leveraging Datavant’s portfolio of real-world evidence (RWE) solutions, analytics platforms, and AI platform and services. This role will partner closely with Client Partners across key accounts for co-selling, account planning, and evidence strategy alignment.

You will serve as a trusted advisor on the use of real-world data (RWD) and RWE to support regulatory, market access, and HEOR needs - representing the voice of the customer and ensuring that Datavant’s offerings meet evolving evidence generation requirements. The ideal candidate is comfortable leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and brings deep expertise in real-world data, evidence platforms, and outcomes research.

What You Will Do

  • Prospect & Generate Leads: Develop and execute strategic plans to identify and target new business opportunities in biopharma, healthcare, and life sciences with a focus on organizations investing in real-world evidence strategies for regulatory submissions, market access, and clinical development.
  • Build Pipeline: Proactively engage prospects via outbound calls, emails, and industry networking to build a robust pipeline of opportunities related to Aetion’s evidence generation, AI, and analytics solutions.
  • Close Deals: Own the full sales process - from initial outreach to contract closure - ensuring alignment between customer evidence needs and Aetion’s RWE offerings, including the Aetion Evidence Platform (AEP) and associated data and consulting services.
  • Client Engagement: Present Aetion’s value proposition in RWE and RWD analytics through compelling demonstrations and business cases that highlight regulatory-grade evidence generation, comparative effectiveness, and real-world outcomes research. Engage with senior stakeholders including heads of HEOR, RWE, Market Access, and Clinical Development.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with marketing, product, and science teams to deliver tailored RWE solution proposals, ensuring alignment with client data strategies, evidence frameworks, and regulatory expectations (e.g., FDA, EMA guidance).
  • Market Expertise: Stay current on RWE market dynamics, technology and AI, regulatory guidance for real-world data, and competitor offerings to position Aetion as a strategic leader and partner of choice in the evidence generation ecosystem.
  • Forecasting & Reporting: Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting in CRM systems, with attention to evidence project cycles, platform usage models, and customer expansion opportunities.
  • Drive Growth: Identify new and upsell opportunities across assigned territories and existing accounts, particularly in expanding RWE adoption for post-approval studies, safety monitoring, and market access support.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Proven Track Record: 6+ years of successful sales experience, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, or SaaS; with a strong preference for experience selling RWE, HEOR, or data analytics solutions. Background in selling AI is also to be considered.
  • RWE Expertise: Deep understanding of real-world data sources, evidence generation methodologies, and use cases across the product lifecycle — from clinical development to commercialization.
  • Hunter Mentality: Skilled at identifying, developing, and closing new RWE-focused opportunities with top biopharma clients.
  • Sales Expertise: Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving scientific, commercial, and data stakeholders.
  • Technology/AI Skill Sets: Proven experience, knowledge, and market understanding on real AI-driven use cases for HEOR and RWE.
  • Presentation Skills: Exceptional ability to communicate scientific and technical value propositions to diverse audiences, including C-suite and RWE/HEOR leadership.
  • CRM Proficiency: Experienced in CRM management for tracking RWE opportunity pipelines and forecasting revenue growth.
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of RWE market trends, regulatory guidance, and payer evidence needs is essential.
  • Collaborative Team Player: Comfortable working with cross-functional science, data, and product teams in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex RWE concepts into impactful narratives for decision-makers.

jobs.jobDescription:
Role Summary

Natera's Oncology Pharma Marketing team is hiring a Lead Campaign Manager to own campaign strategy and execution end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role, not a coordination or support function: you will set the strategy, direct execution across channels and partners, read performance data critically, and drive the tweaks and next moves that make campaigns better. You will report to the Director of Corporate Marketing, and work in close, high-trust partnership with the ONC Marketing VP and cross-functional leaders across creative, agency, and marketing operations.

The right person is able to work autonomously — someone who can build a campaign strategy from a business objective, defend it with data, and hold a professional line with senior stakeholders, including pushing back when the strategy, timeline, or resourcing calls for it.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Own ONC Pharma campaign strategy end to end — from translating business and brand objectives into an integrated, multi-channel campaign plan through launch, in-flight optimization, and retrospective.

• Direct day-to-day execution across channels (digital, email, paid media, content, HCP/patient-facing programs, events), making prioritization calls and tradeoffs as they arise.

• Set the campaign brief and creative direction in partnership with creative and brand teams, ensuring every asset ladders back to strategy.

• Proactively surface risks to timeline, budget, or performance and drive them to resolution — rather than escalating and waiting.

Performance Measurement & Optimization

• Define the KPIs and measurement framework for each campaign; monitor performance in flight rather than only in retrospective.

• Read measurement results critically — translate what happened into specific, actionable tweaks, tests, and recommendations for what to do next.

• Build a continuous test-and-learn discipline into every campaign cycle, and codify what's learned so it compounds across campaigns.

• Present performance results and strategic recommendations directly to senior stakeholders, including the ONC Marketing VP, with clear, well-substantiated rationale.

Cross-Functional & Agency Leadership

• Serve as the senior point of coordination across creative, agency and media partners and marketing operations.

• Drive alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities by facilitating decisions — not simply routing requests or escalating every conflict.

• Manage agency and vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to strategy, quality, and timeline, and redirecting work that misses the mark.

Executive Partnership — Managing Up

• Partner closely with the ONC Marketing VP as a strategic thought partner, bringing a well-reasoned point of view rather than waiting for direction.

• Hold the line on campaign strategy, scope, and prioritization decisions under pressure or scope creep, communicating disagreement professionally and constructively.

• Know when to resolve versus escalate, and when escalating, bring options and a recommendation rather than an open question.

• Give direct, constructive feedback up and across the organization, including to more senior stakeholders, in service of the campaign and the business.

Qualifications

• 12 years in campaign management (or 8 years and a master’s degree in marketing or equivalent) or marketing strategy/execution roles, with a track record of owning strategy end to end rather than executing against someone else's brief. Pharma, biopharma, oncology, or broader life sciences experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated fluency in reading and acting on performance data (e.g., analytics platforms, Power BI, Salesforce, Eloqua or similar marketing automation) — comfortable moving from “what happened” to “what we do about it.”

• Proven experience managing up to and influencing senior stakeholders, including situations requiring diplomatic pushback, boundary-setting, and holding a position under pressure.

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills — able to align creative, agency, and operations partners without formal authority over them.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; skilled at presenting, defending, and adjusting recommendations in front of leadership.

• Experience operating within a regulated pharma marketing environment (MLR / medical-legal review processes) strongly preferred.

• Self-directed, high-ownership operator who brings structure and judgment to a fast-moving oncology pharma environment, and who mentors or sets the bar for junior team members and agency partners without formally managing them.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$125,000—$145,000 USD

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$125,000—$145,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.jobDescription:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Retail team

  • Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

  • Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

  • Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Lead & develop a high-performing sales team: Hire, onboard, and develop AEs across your region, Coach reps on deal strategy, pipeline management, and execution. Create a culture of accountability, learning, and collaboration. Identify and grow future leaders on your team.

  • Own regional performance: Own your regional number and forecast accuracy, Inspect pipeline quality and help unblock stalled deals. Drive consistent execution of our sales process. Partner with RevOps to ensure clean data and clear insights.

  • Be deeply involved in deals: Join key customer and prospect conversations. Help reps navigate complex buying committees and late-stage deals. Support pricing, negotiation, and close strategy.

What you'll bring

  • 10-15+ years of experience: Extensive experience in enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • People leadership experience: 5+ years managing, mentoring, and developing a high-performing enterprise sales team.

  • Enterprise experience: You've run and managed end-to-end complex deals ($1M+).

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends, as well as fluency with AI tooling and workflows.

  • Experience building GTM strategies: Building sales teams and sales motions from scratch, or from early stage growth.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.
