Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

State and Local Government Sales Manager - Northeast (Must be based in the Northeast region)

Why We Have This Role

Why We Have This Role As the SLG Sales Manager, you will lead a high-performing team of sales executives across the U.S. Your team’s overarching objective is to drive company revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and expansion in our current customer base. This leader will be integral to the success of the SLG vertical and broader Public Sector team. We need a talented Sales Manager to enable the SLG sales team to deliver at their highest potential.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Takes initiative
  • Understands the expected outcome, gets the context, and then works entrepreneurially to get it done.
  • Highly communicative and influences effectively, creating trust at the team level.
  • Strong track record of exceeding quota.
  • Ability to acquire clients
  • Strong negotiating skills
  • Ability to sell a complex platform: Qualtrics Experience Management platform to large, strategic accounts

How You’ll Grow

  • Structured promotion process/auto promotion process
  • Career Action Planning with Manager
  • Qmobility

Things You’ll Do

  • Lead an SLG Sales team to drive long-term employee, team, and customer success and scale revenue growth.
  • Be a thought leader and customer advocate with partners to elevate the adoption of experience management (XM) in government.
  • Lead a team of mid-level to senior sales executives selling mid-market and enterprise accounts.
  • Meet quarterly and annual objectives and key results.
  • Manage the business through accurate and timely reporting.
  • Coach direct reports in sales strategy, pipeline management, opportunity management, and career planning/development.
  • Recruit, retain, and nurture your team of experienced sales professionals with high potential and strong performance history.
  • Provide skill training and mentoring on complex sales motions, including collaboration with legal, product presentations, juggling multiple relationships with internal teams, and quarterly sales forecasting.
  • Interface and develop professional relationships with existing clients and prospects throughout all levels of an organization.
  • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of Qualtrics' solution offerings.
  • Maintain a real-time understanding of the competitive landscape to assist in building win-based proposals and pricing.
  • Serve as a key sponsor during enterprise-level deals.
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with other functional areas internally at Qualtrics (e.g., Professional Services, Implementation, Subject Matter Experts) to ensure a collaborative approach to secure large enterprise engagements.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in high-growth technology sales, with at least 2–3 years in a sales leadership/management role (preferably in the public sector industry).
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience selling SaaS solutions.
  • Successful track record leading sales teams in achieving assigned targets.
  • Successful track record providing high-level impact to government clients and partners.
  • Ability to learn and understand product solutions and features with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Experience using enterprise sales processes such as MEDDIC.
  • Experience using CRM such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics and measuring system compliance.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher is required.
  • Preference for candidates to be based at our headquarters in Provo, Utah (or Seattle/Dallas depending on office opening location).

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Our State and Local Government (SLG) sales team is a group of highly driven individuals dedicated to closing experience gaps across SLG’s in the United States.
  • Our SaaS platform is used to help some of the largest government organizations in the world drive action with pre-built experience management (XM) programs and projects that anyone can use.
  • This team is responsible for driving core growth across key government accounts.
  • This team was the highest performing sector in the company last year, where CX and EX are key priorities.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Accelerators
  • Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag
  • We offer private health insurance, and a wellness stipend to allow you to focus on yourself each quarter, and much more

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid

Life Sciences & Payers Sales Leader (U.S.)

Why We Have This Role

The U.S. Life Sciences & Payers Sales Leader will be responsible for defining and executing the growth strategy for these critical business segments. This leader will drive market expansion, deepen relationships with key enterprise accounts, and accelerate significant net-new Annual Contract Value (ACV) growth across highly complex and regulated healthcare organizations.

This executive will lead a high-performing team of frontline sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and results. Serving as the senior go-to-market leader for the segment, they will partner closely with Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Executive Leadership to deliver an integrated customer strategy that drives measurable business outcomes and long-term client value.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the U.S. Life Sciences and Payers ecosystem, a proven track record of scaling enterprise sales organizations, and the ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders across some of the industry's most influential organizations.

How You’ll Find Success

You will define and execute the go-to-market strategy for one of Qualtrics' most strategic growth segments. Success in this role will be measured by your ability to drive predictable revenue growth, expand executive-level customer relationships, and build a high-performing organization that accelerates market leadership across the healthcare ecosystem.

  • Strategic Market Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market strategy for the U.S. Life Sciences and Payers vertical, aligning regional priorities with global business objectives. Identify, prioritize, and penetrate high-value accounts and market segments to drive sustainable growth, increased market share, and long-term customer value.
  • Revenue Growth & Business Expansion: Own and exceed annual revenue goals across net-new ACV, expansion revenue, and renewals. Drive market expansion strategies that deepen customer adoption, increase platform utilization, and position Qualtrics as the leading Experience Management partner across payer and life sciences organizations.
  • Executive Selling & Complex Enterprise Execution: Lead a multi-product enterprise sales motion across complex buying centers and stakeholder groups. Navigate sophisticated procurement environments, build strong C-suite relationships, and demonstrate measurable business impact that positions Qualtrics as a strategic transformation partner.
  • Industry Expertise & Thought Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders by bringing deep knowledge of the U.S. Life Sciences & Payers ecosystem, including health plans, PBMs, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology organizations. Stay ahead of industry trends, regulatory developments, and emerging market opportunities to inform strategy and customer engagement.
  • Ecosystem & Partner Development: Build and strengthen strategic partnerships across healthcare consulting firms, systems integrators, technology providers, and industry influencers. Develop joint go-to-market initiatives that expand market reach, accelerate pipeline generation, and increase win rates.
  • People Leadership & Talent Development: Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales leaders and Enterprise Account Executives. Foster a culture of accountability, coaching, inclusion, and continuous improvement that drives strong employee engagement, career development, and consistent quota attainment.
  • Operational Excellence & Forecast Accuracy: Establish a disciplined operating rhythm built on data-driven decision-making, forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and performance management. Partner closely with Sales Operations to optimize territory planning, resource allocation, sales productivity, and business outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional Influence & Alignment: Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Solution Engineering teams to deliver a unified customer experience. Advocate for market needs, influence product strategy, and ensure successful customer adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Customer-Centric Growth: Champion a customer-first approach that strengthens long-term relationships, drives executive sponsorship, and delivers measurable business outcomes. Ensure customers realize value from their Qualtrics investment while creating opportunities for strategic expansion and advocacy.
  • Culture & Organizational Impact: Model Qualtrics' leadership principles and values by fostering collaboration, transparency, innovation, and high performance. Inspire teams to achieve ambitious goals while building an environment where employees can do their best work.

Pivotal Expertise & Business Impact

Core Capability

Expectation & Impact

Sales Complexity

Proven mastery of complex, enterprise-wide SaaS sales cycles involving multi-buyer consensus (C-suite, clinical, IT, HR) across large healthcare networks.

Ecosystem Expertise

Demonstrated ability to build, negotiate, and leverage partner ecosystem relationships to expand channel reach and co-sell enterprise deals.

Growth at Scale

History of leading enterprise sales teams through rapid scaling ($1B to $5B+ corporate trajectories), driving both strategic new-logo acquisition and land-and-expand account growth.

Operational Rigor

Exceptional operational discipline leveraging sales analytics, key performance indicators, and structured inspection mechanisms to drive reliable pipeline generation and accurate forecasting.

Leadership from the Front

Hands-on executive leader who engages directly in complex sales cycles, coaches teams through high-stakes negotiations, and acts as a force multiplier in key deals.

US Healthcare Domain Authority

Deep understanding of the U.S. Life Sciences and Payer ecosystem, including health plans, PBMs, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology organizations, as well as the regulatory environment, reimbursement models, market access strategies, and key executive stakeholders that influence purchasing decisions and strategic partnerships.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Enterprise SaaS sales experience, with significant tenure dedicated to leading enterprise sales teams ideally selling directly into the US Life Sciences and/or Payers markets.
  • 2+ years of second-line executive sales leadership experience managing multi-layered teams (sales managers and enterprise account executives) preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding complex vertical revenue targets within rapidly scaling organizations ($1B to $5B+).
  • Expertise in direct selling methods as well as building and co-selling alongside strategic partner networks.
  • Proven operational success in leading multi-product, enterprise software motions with long, complex decision-making cycles.
  • Bachelor's degree required; Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Why We Have This Role

The North America Field CTO organization serves as the primary bridge between Qualtrics' product vision, customer strategy, field execution, and market innovation.   • Help your team to drive net-new revenue growth through new logo acquisition and expansion of current accounts

  • Meet quarterly and annual objectives and key results
  • Build strategic account plans to grow the existing business and identify new opportunities with customers and through partners

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 4-6 years of experience selling SaaS solutions to the Federal vertical
  • Prior experience in managing a team of sellers
  • Successful track record in achieving assigned targets within the Federal vertical
  • Successful track record providing executive-level impact to clients and partners
  • Strong management and coaching skills
  • Well-versed in federal procurement processes and regulations
  • Well-versed in federal government security standards and policies
  • Prior experience in building relationships with relevant federal contractors
  • Prior experience in responding to federal government RFI's and RFP's

What You Should Know About This Team

  • The Qualtrics Federal team prides itself on its culture of collaboration, hard working mentality, and winning
  • We are the fastest growing sector within the company
  • The Federal space is just getting started. Join a team that is building something and making a difference for our customers

Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Enterprise Account Executive – Manufacturing

Why We Have This Role

Our Enterprise Account Executive team is a group of highly driven individuals dedicated to closing experience gaps across the world’s leading industrial organizations. In the modern Manufacturing sector—spanning automotive, aerospace, industrial equipment, consumer packaged goods (CPG), and high-tech manufacturing—supply chain resilience, dealer/distributor enablement, product quality feedback, and frontline workforce safety and retention are top priorities. Our SaaS platform empowers global manufacturers to capture real-time operational feedback, elevate customer and partner journeys, and drive action with pre-built Experience Management (XM) programs.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Takes Initiative: Understands the expected outcome, grasps complex industrial ecosystems, and works entrepreneurially to execute.

  • Domain & Industry Acumen: Deep understanding of key business drivers, metrics, and buyer personas in Manufacturing (e.g., B2B customer retention, dealer/distributor satisfaction, product feedback loops, plant floor employee engagement, warranty/service experience, and supply chain partner feedback).

  • Proven Deal Closer: Strong track record of consistently exceeding quota and acquiring high-value enterprise industrial accounts.

  • Complex Solution Selling: Ability to sell a multi-solution, enterprise-grade SaaS platform (Qualtrics Experience Management) into large, matrixed manufacturing enterprises with complex global operations.

  • Strategic Negotiation: Skilled in navigating formal procurement procedures, multi-stakeholder consensus building, vendor risk assessments, and enterprise contract negotiations.

How You'll Grow

  • Structured, 100% performance-based promotion pathway.

  • Dedicated Career Action Planning alongside your leadership team.

  • Internal mobility opportunities (Qmobility) across global teams and territories.

Things You’ll Do

  • Quarterback strategic enterprise deals with Fortune 500 manufacturers, automotive OEMs, industrial equipment providers, and CPG giants in your territory.

  • Consistently hit and exceed quarterly and annual revenue quotas.

  • Cultivate C-level and VP-level relationships across Commercial Operations, Customer Experience (CX), Product Strategy, Supply Chain, Field Service, and Human Resources.

  • Develop and maintain deep domain knowledge of Qualtrics’ XM offerings and how they solve manufacturing challenges (e.g., B2B client health, dealer network experience, product quality feedback, frontline plant worker retention, and Voice of the Customer/Partner).

  • Maintain a real-time understanding of the competitive landscape to build win-based proposals and strategic pricing models.

  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams (Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, SME Leads, and Customer Success) to orchestrate collaborative, high-impact enterprise sales cycles.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • A validated top performer with a proven track record of breakthrough sales results.

  • 5–10+ years of direct enterprise SaaS sales experience, preferably targeting Manufacturing, Industrial, Supply Chain, or Automotive sectors.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher required.

  • Demonstrated mastery of the MEDDPICC / MEDDIC sales process.

  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce.com and sales forecasting hygiene.

  • Experience developing complex business cases and ROI models focused on account retention, dealer network loyalty, product quality insights, and workforce productivity.

  • Proven track record of navigating long, complex contract negotiations with global manufacturing enterprises.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% as needed for key client site visits, executive briefings, and industry summits.

What You Should Know About This Team

Our Manufacturing team is dedicated to meeting surging demand from enterprise industrial leaders who are digitizing their operations and transforming how they engage customers, distributors, and frontline employees. We are a goal-oriented, strategic, and high-energy team that collaborates closely to navigate complex sales cycles and win market leadership. Our overarching objective is to drive exponential revenue growth by helping global manufacturers deliver exceptional experiences from the factory floor to the end customer.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Performance Accelerators.

  • Merit-Based Growth: 100% performance-based promotions—driven by results, not politics or tenure.

  • Culture: A vibrant, inclusive work environment—wear jeans and bring your dog to the office anytime.

  • Team & Swag: Quarterly team outings, winter and summer parties, and exclusive team swag.

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive private health insurance, wellness stipend, and rich mental/physical health benefits.

  • Qualtrics Experience Bonus: An annual cash bonus designed specifically for you to fund a personal dream experience—whether that’s a dream vacation, attending a major event, or personal passion projects.

Enterprise Account Executive - Healthcare Providers (West)

Why We Have This Role

The Healthcare Provider industry is at a pivotal intersection of patient outcomes and experience management. Qualtrics is poised to be the organization that ushers in the next level of maturity in the category of Experience Management (XM) for the world’s leading health systems, hospitals, and clinics. This is a rare opportunity to lead the acceleration of a high-priority vertical in the enterprise XM category. You will have the greenfield opportunity to carve out strategic territories and help shape our go-to-market strategy, but you will do so backed by the undisputed market leader.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Strategic Orchestration: You view your territory as a business. You effectively quarterback a cross-functional team, leveraging dedicated Industry Scientists, Engineers, and Operations Experts to structure and close complex deals. This is an individual contributor role that will succeed by leading teams through influence.

  • Vertical Fluency: You move beyond features and functions to align XM with critical C-level healthcare initiatives such as improving patient experience (e.g., HCAHPS), reducing care team burnout, and optimizing clinical and operational effectiveness.

  • Operational Rigor: You treat sales as a science, utilizing methodologies (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) to forecast accurately, build a sustainable 4x pipeline, and deliver consistently on financial growth targets (quota) for new and expansion business.

  • Client Planning: Create comprehensive client plans that outline strategies for achieving client objectives and financial growth targets.

How You’ll Grow

  • Meritocratic Progression: We have a structured, transparent promotion path based on performance, not tenure.

  • Qmobility: Success in this role opens doors to leadership, vertical management, or other functional areas within Qualtrics globally.

  • Wealth Creation: Competitive base salary, uncapped commissions, and aggressive accelerators for over-performance.

Things You’ll Do

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the overall strategic relationship manager for the client and be responsible for retaining existing client revenue through outstanding relationships at all levels, especially within the C-suite.

  • Acquire & Expand: Analyze client needs and market trends to identify opportunities for growth and expansion within the client and/or territory. Drive revenue growth by landing new strategic logos and expanding our footprint within existing Provider accounts.

  • Present & Propose: Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and product demonstrations. Create and present detailed sales proposals tailored to the specific needs of healthcare clients.

  • Complex Negotiation: Negotiate terms of sales agreements to maximize revenue and profit, skillfully navigating the procurement, legal, and security landscapes typical of the healthcare industry.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work cross-functionally across Qualtrics, specifically partnering with Client Success, Implementation, and Advisory teams, to fulfill the client value proposition and address client needs/concerns.

  • Product Mastery: Gain and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the entire product portfolio (features, benefits, use cases) and understand how Qualtrics compares to competitors' offerings. Participate in all required training sessions, workshops, and webinars.

  • CRM Administration: Maintain up-to-date records of all sales activities and client interactions in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system (Salesforce).

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • Experience: 3-6 years of enterprise closing sales experience.

  • SaaS Acumen: Full-cycle Enterprise sales experience with familiarity of sales methodologies (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) and CRM hygiene. SaaS solutions experience highly preferred.

  • Industry Knowledge: An understanding of the unique opportunities and challenges within the healthcare provider space.

  • Core Skills: Excellent interpersonal, communication, listening, and presentation skills. Strong relationship-building skills and demonstrated organizational qualities.

  • Validated Winner: Must be results-driven with a solid working knowledge of strategic planning, execution of strategy, and business development. Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • We have grown our Enterprise Sales team to respond to overwhelming client demand.
  • We are a group of intelligent, intense, and collaborative professionals who celebrate collective wins as much as individual achievements.
  • We operate with the agility of a startup, moving fast to capture market share but with the resources of an enterprise organization with year-on-year success.
  • If you are looking for a role where you can have a tangible impact on the trajectory of a vertical while accelerating your own career, this is the place.

jobs.jobDescription:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.
  • Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.
  • Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.
  • Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.
  • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

✅ You have...

  • 8+ years of direct digital ad sales experience with a consistent track record of hunting, closing, and renewing in premium mobile or consumer app environments.
  • Success selling video and native/custom formats and structuring innovative agreements with top‑tier advertisers and agencies.
  • Proven ability to engage senior decision makers while rolling up your sleeves to build collateral, troubleshoot issues, and drive revenue personally.
  • Strong understanding of ad tech and mobile app ecosystems, with skill using data to assess performance and inform pricing and packaging.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, and comfort operating with ambiguity at high velocity.

⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Established relationships across West Coast brand and agency decision makers.
  • Experience introducing or scaling a new ads product from 0→1 within a publisher or platform environment.
  • Experience shaping regional GTM, sales process, or coverage models beyond an individual book of business.
  • Familiarity partnering with Account Management and Ad Ops on native/custom programs and live‑campaign storytelling to drive renewals.
  • Vertical expertise in Entertainment, Gaming, Streaming, or Tech that accelerates early traction.

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Enterprise Sales 1 - Healthcare Providers (Central)

Why We Have This Role The Healthcare Provider industry is at a pivotal intersection of patient outcomes and experience management. Qualtrics is poised to be the organization that ushers in the next level of maturity in the category of Experience Management (XM) for the world’s leading health systems, hospitals, and clinics. This is a rare opportunity to lead the acceleration of a high-priority vertical in the enterprise XM category. You will have the greenfield opportunity to carve out strategic territories and help shape our go-to-market strategy, but you will do so backed by the undisputed market leader.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Strategic Orchestration: You view your territory as a business. You effectively quarterback a cross-functional team, leveraging dedicated Industry Scientists, Engineers, and Operations Experts to structure and close complex deals. This is an individual contributor role that will succeed by leading teams through influence.

  • Vertical Fluency: You move beyond features and functions to align XM with critical C-level healthcare initiatives such as improving patient experience (e.g., HCAHPS), reducing care team burnout, and optimizing clinical and operational effectiveness.

  • Operational Rigor: You treat sales as a science, utilizing methodologies (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) to forecast accurately, build a sustainable 4x pipeline, and deliver consistently on financial growth targets (quota) for new and expansion business.

  • Client Planning: Create comprehensive client plans that outline strategies for achieving client objectives and financial growth targets.

How You’ll Grow

  • Meritocratic Progression: We have a structured, transparent promotion path based on performance, not tenure.

  • Qmobility: Success in this role opens doors to leadership, vertical management, or other functional areas within Qualtrics globally.

  • Wealth Creation: Competitive base salary, uncapped commissions, and aggressive accelerators for over-performance.

Things You’ll Do

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the overall strategic relationship manager for the client and be responsible for retaining existing client revenue through outstanding relationships at all levels, especially within the C-suite.

  • Acquire & Expand: Analyze client needs and market trends to identify opportunities for growth and expansion within the client and/or territory. Drive revenue growth by landing new strategic logos and expanding our footprint within existing Provider accounts.

  • Present & Propose: Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and product demonstrations. Create and present detailed sales proposals tailored to the specific needs of healthcare clients.

  • Complex Negotiation: Negotiate terms of sales agreements to maximize revenue and profit, skillfully navigating the procurement, legal, and security landscapes typical of the healthcare industry.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work cross-functionally across Qualtrics, specifically partnering with Client Success, Implementation, and Advisory teams, to fulfill the client value proposition and address client needs/concerns.

  • Product Mastery: Gain and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the entire product portfolio (features, benefits, use cases) and understand how Qualtrics compares to competitors' offerings. Participate in all required training sessions, workshops, and webinars.

  • CRM Administration: Maintain up-to-date records of all sales activities and client interactions in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system (Salesforce).

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 3-6 years of enterprise closing sales experience.

  • SaaS Acumen: Full-cycle Enterprise sales experience with familiarity of sales methodologies (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) and CRM hygiene. SaaS solutions experience highly preferred.

  • Industry Knowledge: An understanding of the unique opportunities and challenges within the healthcare provider space.

  • Core Skills: Excellent interpersonal, communication, listening, and presentation skills. Strong relationship-building skills and demonstrated organizational qualities.

  • Validated Winner: Must be results-driven with a solid working knowledge of strategic planning, execution of strategy, and business development. Bachelor’s degree or higher.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We have grown our Enterprise Sales team to respond to overwhelming client demand.
  • We are a group of intelligent, intense, and collaborative professionals who celebrate collective wins as much as individual achievements.
  • We operate with the agility of a startup, moving fast to capture market share but with the resources of an enterprise organization with year-on-year success.
  • If you are looking for a role where you can have a tangible impact on the trajectory of a vertical while accelerating your own career, this is the place.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Accelerators
  • 100% Performance based promotions -- not politics or tenure
  • Culture - Incredible work environment - you can wear jeans and bring your dog to the office, anytime
  • Quarterly team activities, winter and summer parties, and lots of Qualtrics swag
  • We offer private health insurance, annual experience bonus, wellness stipend to allow you to focus on yourself each quarter, and much more

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.
  • Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.
  • Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.
  • Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.
  • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

✅ You have...

  • 8+ years of direct digital ad sales experience with a consistent track record of hunting, closing, and renewing in premium mobile or consumer app environments.
  • Success selling video and native/custom formats and structuring innovative agreements with top‑tier advertisers and agencies.
  • Proven ability to engage senior decision makers while rolling up your sleeves to build collateral, troubleshoot issues, and drive revenue personally.
  • Strong understanding of ad tech and mobile app ecosystems, with skill using data to assess performance and inform pricing and packaging.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, and comfort operating with ambiguity at high velocity.

⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Established relationships across West Coast brand and agency decision makers.
  • Experience introducing or scaling a new ads product from 0→1 within a publisher or platform environment.
  • Experience shaping regional GTM, sales process, or coverage models beyond an individual book of business.
  • Familiarity partnering with Account Management and Ad Ops on native/custom programs and live‑campaign storytelling to drive renewals.
  • Vertical expertise in Entertainment, Gaming, Streaming, or Tech that accelerates early traction.

About impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

In this role, the Associate Solutions Architect bridges business and technical requirements with impact.com’s capabilities to shape solution designs, drive technical alignment, and position impact.com as the right partnership management platform for the prospect. Working alongside Account Executives, the Associate Solutions Architect acts as a product expert in the sales process and communicates the requirements of the technical implementation in a clear and confident manner that instills trust in impact.com’s ability to deliver.

The Associate Solutions Architect supports SMB opportunities and serves as a technical resource for commonly used integrations, ensuring prospects are positioned for successful onboarding.

What You'll Do:

  • Support Account Executives as a pre-sales technical resource for SMB opportunities
  • Discover and document prospect technical and product requirements
  • Develop solution and integration documentation for prospects
  • Deliver structured product demonstrations tailored to SMB use cases
  • Respond to standard technical and implementation questions
  • Escalate non-standard or complex requirements as needed
  • Ensure prospects are positioned for successful onboarding
  • Other duties as assigned by the Company

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with a job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
  • 1–3 years in a tech-focused role within a SaaS or digital marketing company
  • Foundational understanding of APIs, JavaScript, and marketing technology platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to lead structured client-facing technical conversations within defined scope
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

Additional education, experience, knowledge, skills, & abilities that will contribute to, but are not required for success in this role

  • Experience in a pre-sales or client-facing technical role
  • Familiarity with affiliate or digital marketing industry

Salary Range: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year, plus an additional 15% variable annual bonus contingent on Company performance and eligible to receive a Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) grant.

*This is the pay range the Company believes is equitable for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Office-only catered lunch every Thursday, a healthy snack bar, and great coffee to keep you fueled
  • Flexible spending accounts and 401(k)
  • Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
  • Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
  • A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
  • Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
  • Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
  • Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

Gopuff is hiring a Senior Integrated Marketing Manager to bring our biggest marketing initiatives to life.

You’ll own the integrated approach for campaigns across brand, talent partnerships, cultural moments, and strategic growth initiatives, turning an idea or business priority into a clear, coordinated plan across channels, teams, and partners.

This role sits at the center of the work. You’ll connect strategy, creative, media, partnerships, performance, CRM, and external partners to ensure campaigns don’t just get developed; they get launched, show up cohesively, and make an impact.

We’re looking for someone with a strong point of view, a bias for action, and a genuine sense of ownership. Someone with impeccable taste who holds themselves and their work to the highest standard. You should be equally comfortable shaping the plan, writing the brief, pushing the creative, solving the problem, and getting the work out into the world.

Gopuff moves quickly. Priorities evolve. The best person for this role knows how to create clarity from ambiguity, bring people with them, and keep moving.

What We Offer

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • HSA or FSA eligibility
  • Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program
  • 25% employee discount & FAM Membership
  • Flexible PTO
  • Group Life Insurance
  • EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)

Responsibilities

Integrated Campaigns and Cultural Moments

  • Own the integrated execution of major Gopuff campaigns across brand, product, growth, and the cultural calendar. From the Super Bowl to product launches, cultural moments, and everything in between.

  • Turn strategy into clear, actionable campaign plans across creative, media, social, CRM, performance, partnerships, and in-app channels.

  • Build briefs that give creative and cross-functional teams a clear problem to solve and a strong definition of success.

  • Keep teams aligned from kickoff through launch, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected to the same idea.

  • Identify cultural opportunities where Gopuff can show up credibly and move quickly enough to capitalize on them.

Talent & Brand Partnerships

  • Lead campaigns around Gopuff’s talent and brand partnerships, from initial concept through launch and measurement.

  • Develop creative partnership ideas that connect Gopuff to culture and create attention beyond traditional paid media.

  • Translate partnerships into broader marketing platforms, ensuring they come to life across the full Gopuff ecosystem rather than as standalone activations.

  • Serve as a day-to-day lead with talent teams, agencies, brands, and external partners, keeping the work moving and the quality high.

Strategic Growth Initiatives

  • Turn strategic business priorities into integrated marketing plans with clear objectives, audiences, channels, and measures of success.

  • Identify opportunities where marketing and the Gopuff brand can play a bigger role in driving growth.

  • Partner across Brand, Performance, CRM, Product, Merchandising, and other teams to build campaigns that connect brand impact with business outcomes.

  • Analyze performance, identify what worked and what didn’t, and translate learnings into stronger future work.

Operating & Ownership

  • Own campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, approvals, and cross-functional coordination from start to finish.

  • Proactively identify roadblocks and solve them before they become problems.

  • Drive legal, regulatory, and partner approvals to keep campaigns moving.

  • Maintain a high creative bar across every consumer touchpoint.

  • Take responsibility for the outcome, not just your piece of the process.

You Have

  • 7+ years in brand marketing, integrated marketing, media/publishing, agency strategy/creative work, or all of the above.

  • A track record of taking ambiguous challenges and turning them into shipped experiences, not decks.

  • Strong startup instincts. You define the process, chase the approval, and cover the gap nobody assigned to you.

  • A high bar for creative and craft, with the taste to know good from good enough.

  • The business backbone to defend a decision with numbers, not just conviction.

  • Experience managing partners, budgets, and multiple live projects at once, without dropping any of them.

  • Direct, efficient communication.

  • Motivated to win.

Compensation

  • Gopuff pays employees based on market pricing and pay may vary depending on your location. The salary range below reflects what we’d reasonably expect to pay candidates. A candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role.
  • This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan.
  • Remote Base Salary Range: $150,000 - $190,000

Compensation

Additional Information

At Gopuff, we know that life can be unpredictable. Sometimes you forget the milk at the store, run out of pet food for Fido, or just really need ice cream at 11 pm. We get it—stuff happens. But that’s where we come in, delivering all your wants and needs in just minutes.

And now, we’re assembling a team of motivated people to help us drive forward that vision to bring a new age of convenience and predictability to an unpredictable world.

Like what you’re hearing? Then join us on Team Blue.

#LI-GOPUFF

We believe in diversity and encourage any qualified individual to apply.

jobs.jobDescription:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Healthcare team

  • Our healthcare agents already reach over 50% of U.S. families. We partner with leading health plans, providers, and healthcare platforms to deliver AI agents that handle some of the most sensitive and high stakes conversations in any industry. From helping members understand their benefits to resolving billing questions with empathy, our healthcare agents are transforming how patients and policyholders interact with the healthcare system.

  • Our healthcare customers include major health insurance networks, nonprofit providers, multi-site primary and urgent care practices, healthcare diagnostics companies, and healthcare financial platforms.

  • Join us to transform the patient experience across the healthcare system—and help build technology that makes care more accessible, more human and more affordable for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Independently drive complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Manage a broad enterprise book with strong autonomy, leading 6- and 7-figure deal cycles from prospecting to close.

  • Multi-thread to the C-suite: Lead VP-level conversations, build durable C-suite relationships across customer orgs, and earn credibility quickly with new stakeholders.

  • Manage risk proactively: Identify and manage deal risk early; build rigorous stakeholder maps for your accounts.

  • Make the hard calls: Partner with your manager (and, at the senior level, operate more independently) on pricing, escalation timing, exec alignment, and deal strategy — coming to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

  • Leverage leadership & co-founders: Bring in Sierra's co-founders effectively for exec engagement when it moves a deal.

  • Raise the bar: Act as a visible, steady leader on deal teams; proactively elevate the team's standard without being asked.

  • Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

What you'll bring

  • 8- 10 years of enterprise customer-facing sales experience, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

  • Proven ability to multi-thread and build trusted relationships across customer C-suites.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication.

  • Analytical mindset - you analyze market trends, spot opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

Even better...

  • Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.jobDescription:
The Audiobooks Mission is a team in the Product & Technology organisation focused on the ecosystem and strategies of Audiobooks on Spotify. We work across both the creator and consumer audiobooks ecosystems, in order to get the best possible product to market with the best possible content.

Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.

You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and evaluate audiobook catalogs from independent authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners that will resonate with Spotify listeners.
  • Negotiate audiobook licensing agreements and commercial partnerships that create long-term value for Spotify and our publishing partners.
  • Build trusted relationships across a diverse portfolio of independent publishers, distributors, and authors, serving as their primary strategic contact.
  • Develop creative partnership structures that support sustainable growth while meeting the evolving needs of creators and publishing businesses.
  • Use market insights, performance analytics, and commercial data to inform acquisition strategies and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Partner with creators and publishers to optimize catalog performance, improve discoverability, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to improve partner experience and support Spotify's audiobook strategy.
  • Advocate internally for the needs of independent creators and publishers, helping shape future product capabilities and strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to initiatives focused on catalog expansion, subscriber value, listening growth, operational excellence, and blended cost per content hour (CPCH) optimization.

Who You Are

  • You have 3+ years of experience in publishing, digital media, business development, content licensing, content partnerships, or a related field.
  • You have experience negotiating and closing commercial licensing, distribution, or partnership agreements.
  • You have a strong understanding of the independent publishing ecosystem, including indie authors, hybrid publishers, audiobook distributors, and digital publishing models.
  • You understand the unique opportunities and challenges facing entrepreneurial creators and independent publishing businesses.
  • You build trusted relationships and effectively influence a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • You use data, financial insights, and market trends to inform commercial decisions and partnership strategies.
  • You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership, and finding practical solutions to complex business challenges.
  • You care about helping creators succeed and are passionate about audiobooks, storytelling, and the evolving creator economy.
  • You hold a Bachelor's degree; an MBA or other advanced degree is beneficial.
  • You are comfortable collaborating across multiple time zones and are willing to travel when needed.

Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is $74,000 – $106,000 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world’s most beloved companies, including Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton, and 50+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.

The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028. We’re building the infrastructure behind that shift, helping brands turn resale into a meaningful part of their business and helping consumers rethink how they shop. If you’re excited to change consumer behavior for the better, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Account-Based Marketing to own how Archive gets in front of the brands we want to work with, and to build the system that engineers that outcome at the account level, not just the individual outreach level.

This isn't a broad-funnel ABM role. Our current TAM is roughly 300 named brands across apparel, footwear, children's bikes, and kitchen supplies. There is no "tier 3, spray-and-pray" segment here. Every account matters, every buying committee is knowable, and the job is to be the sharpest, best-informed presence in the room before an AE ever gets on the phone. Precision, brand craft, and creativity are what win at Archive. That's where you come in.

This is a role for someone who can map an entire buying committee at a target brand, know who owns the customer acquisition number, who owns the brand and full-price growth, who evaluates operational lift, and where sustainability sits in the decision.

Responsibilities

  • Own the number. You'll carry the account-based marketing target; meetings held and opportunities created across our named account list, forecast it accurately, and report progress account by account, not just in aggregate. You'll also own the leading indicators that predict those outcomes; how deep we've penetrated each buying committee, and whether our core business case is actually landing in the accounts we're working.

  • Own the account universe. ~300 target accounts, segmented by brand type and firmographics, each defined buying committee (CFO & CMO as economic buyer and strategic sponsor; VP Ecomm; Ops & Sustainability as influencers and technical evaluators) and a play built for that specific group. Priority accounts get 1:1 orchestration; mid-tier gets 1:few cluster plays; the long tail gets scaled-but-still-personal sequencing. Every account is AE-owned, so tight, constant coordination with the sales team is critical.

  • Monitor signals, don't wait for them. This is the core shift from a traditional demand-gen motion: you're watching for buying signals at both the account and individual-stakeholder level; champion changing jobs, a new CMO or CFO appointment, public commentary on rising customer acquisition costs, a competitor's contracting renewing, a competitor launching resale. You decide when an account is ready to be worked and by which channel, rather than running the same cadence on every account regardless of readiness.

  • Orchestrate multi-channel, not single-channel. Email, LinkedIn, paid social, direct mail, events, and warm-intro plays all need to work together per account, sequenced around the signal and the stakeholder- not run as parallel, disconnected campaigns. You'll design and manage the automation and tooling that sequences these consistently, while making the individual judgment calls on tone, timing, and channel mix that automation can't.

  • Write, and direct AI to write, outbound that earns a reply. BASHOs, ghostwritten executive outreach, sequences, campaign copy. Some of this you'll write yourself; increasingly, you'll be directing AI tools to generate first drafts and message variants across a buying committee at scale, then editing and approving for brand voice, accuracy, and craft. The bar doesn't drop because a machine drafted it; you're the last line of quality control on every message that goes out under Archive's name.

  • Be creative about how we get in. Some of our best deals started because someone shopped a partner's resale site, met us at a dinner, or was introduced by a friend of a friend. With a finite, named account list, the job is fundamentally about finding non-obvious angles into accounts that haven't responded to conventional outreach, and running structured experiments to find out what does work.

  • Design the system, not just the campaign. The part of this job that compounds: how account/contact research, signal detection, enrichment, sequencing, CRM, and reporting fit together so the next account you approach takes a fraction of the manual effort the last one did. You'll own the stack in partnership with RevOps; what we add, consolidate, or cut, and the attribution model that tells us which channels and plays actually moved accounts forward.

  • Run paid as air cover, targeted at accounts, not audiences. LinkedIn and paid social exist so the buying committee at a target account already recognizes Archive before outreach lands, not to generate generic leads. You'll own the programs, the budget, account-level targeting, and a defensible read on what's working.

  • Build and rebuild workflows with AI, deliberately. Archive is AI-first. We want someone who has already implemented AI-driven workflows for signal monitoring, research/enrichment, or content generation, not someone who's curious to start. The expectation is a motion that operates with the account-level precision and output of a much larger team, while the strategic judgment (which account, which angle, which moment) stays firmly human.

  • Partner with sales, properly. You'll work alongside two AEs daily. You won't always be the one sending the message, but you're responsible for coordinating the account strategy, the quality of every touch, and the momentum on every account in flight. Creating leverage for others requires enough organization and clarity of reasoning that experienced sellers trust and run your plays without you having to check in constantly.

  • Deploy Archive's secondary market intelligence. We can show a prospect what their brand is actually selling for across resale marketplaces right now; unit volume, price realization against retail, category mix, and what they're capturing none of. Almost no brand has ever seen this about themselves. Turning it into a repeatable, personalized, account level asset is among the highest leverage things this role will own.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in ABM, demand generation, growth marketing, or outbound strategy, at least some of it in B2B with considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Direct ABM experience; you've run account-level (not just persona-level) campaigns, and can talk specifically about how you mapped a buying committee and sequenced multi-channel touches against it.

  • You can write to a CFO & CMO. Our economic buyer(s) cares about customer acquisition cost, payback period, and revenue growth. You don't need to be a finance person, but you do need to construct and communicate commercial argument credibly enough that a CFO takes the meeting.

  • You believe in the power of secondhand to transform the industry - and you understand that the way to get brands there is a commercial case, not a value pitch. The sustainability story closes. The growth story opens.

  • You are an exceptional writer. You can research a brand and a person and produce outreach that earns a reply, and you take real pride in the craft. We will ask you to demonstrate this.

  • You think in systems. You can describe an ABM engine you designed, not just operated, where research, signal, sequencing, and reporting connected end to end and got easier to run the second time.

  • You're AI-native, with specifics. You can walk us through at least two workflows you personally built or rebuilt using AI tooling; ideally including signal detection, account/contact research, or content generation at the buying-committee level.

  • You're creative and a bit relentless. When the account list is small, finite, and known, the job becomes about finding the angle no one else has tried. You have a track record of unconventional plays that worked, and a clear-eyed view of the ones that didn't.

  • You execute. There is no team beneath you. You own the strategy and you build the thing.

  • You're organized enough to drive other people. You can hold AEs and a BDR to account-level commitments you don't have direct authority over, and keep dozens of account plays moving without dropping any.

  • You can build credibility with an adjacent team. You can describe a time you had to earn trust from sellers or another function, and what actually changed their minds.

  • You're comfortable in Salesforce and a modern GTM/ABM stack. We currently use Clay, Apollo, Sales Navigator, Gong, and HubSpot. You have opinions on how these should fit together; including where a dedicated ABM or intent-signal platform would earn its place, and what's overkill for a 300-account universe.

  • You're data-literate and comfortable owning a number, reporting account-level progress toward it, and explaining why an account moved or stalled.

  • You care about sustainability and believe in the power of secondhand shopping to transform the industry.

Bonus Requirements

  • Experience selling into retail, fashion, apparel, or consumer brands.

  • Experience marketing to CMOs and CFOs.

  • Experience with intent-data or signal-monitoring platforms as part of an ABM motion.

  • Events experience: conferences, hosted dinners, in-person networking as an account-entry channel.

  • Salesforce administration or RevOps depth.

  • You've been the first or only ABM/demand-gen hire somewhere before.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is $115,000- 145,000, USD. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) such as role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible for equity as well, and all employees are eligible for a full benefits package including employee and dependent healthcare and 401(k) enrollment.

Archive is a Series B company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Energize Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures, and was named Fast Company's #2 Most Innovative Company in Retail in 2024. We're a small team with low egos and high agency, working on a problem that actually matters- and having a lot of fun doing it.

This is a remote role open across the continental US. We have offices in New York and the SF Bay Area, with hybrid options for those nearby.

We consider applicants of all backgrounds. If you are excited about what we're building but don't meet some of the criteria above, please don't let that discourage you from applying. Please note that we are unable to accept applications from candidates outside of the US at this time.
