jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative - Activate.

About the job

Twilio’s Self-Service Business, serves more than 300,000 active customers and generates nearly $1B annually. This position is needed to grow and retain high-value self-service accounts by engaging customers at the right moment, guiding product adoption, preventing churn, and helping customers reach scale across Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Engage high-value self-service customers through programmatically assigned inbound and outbound leads.
  • Identify growth opportunities by assessing product usage signals, customer needs, and readiness to scale.
  • Guide customers through adoption of Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products to accelerate business outcomes.
  • Retain priority accounts by proactively addressing risks, removing blockers, and supporting continued product value.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Product teams to improve sales plays and customer engagement strategies.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • At least 1 year of sales development or business development experience at a technology company, or 2-3+ years of closing experience in another industry.
  • Ability to qualify inbound and outbound opportunities, uncover customer needs, and guide customers toward relevant solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders.
  • Comfort using data, product usage signals, and sales plays to prioritize outreach and identify growth or retention opportunities.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume book of accounts, prioritize effectively, and follow through on customer commitments.
  • Curiosity about cloud communications, customer engagement, email, data, or SaaS products.

Desired:

  • Experience selling SaaS, cloud communications, email, customer data, or developer-focused products.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth, self-service customer motions, or usage-based sales models.
  • Ability to interpret customer usage trends and translate insights into relevant sales conversations.
  • Experience working with Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, or similar sales engagement and CRM tools.
  • Interest in helping customers adopt and scale solutions across Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, IL, MA, MD, NJ, NY, OR, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, or Washington DC.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $30.09/hr - $37.61/hr.
  • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $31.77/hr - $39.71/hr.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $33.44/hr - $41.80/hr.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. About the Growth Marketing Team

We're a data-driven, highly collaborative team focused on driving sustainable customer growth across paid marketing channels. We combine performance rigor with creative experimentation to unlock meaningful contribution and deliver against Thumbtack's mission of helping homeowners and home professionals accomplish more.

About the role

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to drive core business performance and scale Thumbtack's rapidly growing Paid Social program across channels like Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit.

You're a builder at heart: someone who owns their numbers, pushes ideas outside the current playbook, and has taken a channel or audience from 0 to 1 and made it stick, while collaborating with Creative, Analytics, Martech, and driving performance forward with AI and automation. If you love uncovering the next lever before anyone else sees it, this role is built for you.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and efficiently scale Thumbtack's Consumer Paid Social campaigns across platforms like Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit, driving incremental customer growth and revenue

  • Identify and execute opportunities for channel expansion and unlocking new Social platforms to drive the next frontier of core customer growth

  • Drive our end-to-end emergent Pro (B2B) strategy and execution across Social channels

  • Own in-house campaign management and optimizations, including budget pacing, bid optimization, creative iteration, audience segmentation, and platform best practices

  • Build and implement Paid Social testing roadmaps with cross-functional partners, driving a continuous test-and-learn approach across audiences, creative, and platforms

  • Own tracking, QA, reporting, and measurement for Paid Social, partnering with internal and third-party tools to ensure confidence in results

  • Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to develop and iterate thumb-stopping, performance-driven creative that also advances Thumbtack's brand narrative

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • Bachelor's/Master's in Marketing, Business, Statistics, Economics, or a related field preferred

  • 6+ years of experience managing, scaling, and evolving paid social programs at $X-XX million monthly spend

  • Deep platform and technical expertise in social platforms, with a minimum of 2+ such as Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit

  • Proven track record of unlocking growth from new channels and tactics across creative, martech, and AI tooling

  • Strong analytical chops, with experience in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups) and hands-on comfort with incrementality, MMM, A/B testing, lift testing, and attribution frameworks

  • Confident communicator with proven experience collaborating with multiple cross-functional partners

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, high-stakes growth org, with a bias for action, experimentation, and results

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $123,300 - $159,500.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $111,400 - $144,100.

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Volcano (volcano.dev) is a cloud for apps built with coding agents. You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. Most platforms were designed around a person in a console and added agent support later. We started from the agent.

We're a small team and launched publicly in September 2026. Volcano is incubated by Kong and runs as its own company with its own brand.

This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the Volcano Cookbook: recipes that build real apps on Volcano with tools developers already use, written up with the code, the decisions and the gotchas.

  • Build templates and examples people can deploy in one step.

  • Make video, including YouTube, streams and short demos.

  • Run Volcano hackathons, show up at others, and decide which sponsorships are worth doing.

  • Work with the companies whose tools appear in our recipes on joint content.

  • Spend time where developers ask questions, in Discord, on X and on GitHub, and bring what you hear back to the team.

  • Build the tooling and workflows that let a small team publish more without the quality slipping.

  • Be customer zero. You'll hit rough edges before users do, and engineers should be able to act on your reports.

Who You'll Bring:

  • You've built things in public in the last year and can show us what you shipped and how you told people about it.

  • You've done 0-to-1 work: started a company, joined one early, or launched something from nothing.

  • You're technical and fluent with coding agents. You don't need to be a database or infrastructure expert, but you can build a working app with Claude Code or similar, debug it when it breaks, and explain what happened.

  • You write well. You use AI in your own workflow, and you can tell when output reads like slop.

  • You like explaining things, whether to a room, a camera or a thread of skeptical replies.

  • Engineers trust you on technical accuracy.

Bonus Points:

  • An existing developer audience

  • Hackathon organizing experience

  • Experience with developer platforms like Vercel, Supabase, Neon or Cloudflare.

About the Brand Strategy Team

We act as the architects of the Thumbtack brand - claiming a distinct position in the market, defining a brand promise that delivers on that position, and partnering with skilled experts across the company to bring it to life. Our work spans brand insights, brand strategy, content strategy, and integrated marketing. We set the roadmap for the brand and extend our influence beyond Marketing & Communications into all parts of the organization to make sure every touchpoint strengthens the brand.

About the role

As the Senior Brand Manager focused on our pro audience, you’ll help define how we position the company, what we promise pros, and how that promise comes to life across every touchpoint. Reporting directly to the Director of Brand Strategy, you’ll set vision for major brand workstreams while shaping how the team and the company think about the pro side of our brand.

What you’ll do

  • Lead foundational workstreams to help roll out our new brand playbook, including defining pro positioning and content strategy, educating and training partner teams, and more — and refresh these artifacts as the market shifts and new learnings emerge.

  • Identify high-leverage opportunities for the brand to drive growth on the pro side of our business, then translate them into clear creative briefs and strategic direction for internal and external creative partners.

  • Own pro brand insights work that informs strategy — including audience deep dives, creative experimentation, competitive analysis, and brand health tracking — and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Partner with channel owners across Marketing and Communications to translate pro brand strategy into an integrated content strategy and creative calendar that meets business and brand goals.

  • Extend the brand’s influence beyond Marketing and Communications by building relationships with cross-functional partners in the product, service and sales organizations; create proactive moments to communicate brand vision and align company priorities to it.

  • Lead brand support for AI-driven content, building prompts, skills, brand review systems, and other infrastructure that allows the brand to scale as content creation becomes more decentralized.

  • Orchestrate brand strategy and creative work for tentpole moments, including campaign launches, product launches, and major events like our annual Pro Summit.

  • Serve as a senior voice on the Brand Strategy team — setting standards, shaping how we work, and driving alignment with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 6-8+ years of brand marketing experience, with a strong focus on brand strategy, positioning, and messaging; experience marketing to SMBs is a plus

  • Experience defining and implementing brand strategy - including brand promises, positioning frameworks, playbooks, and messaging architecture

  • Experience setting brand vision and roadmap, not just managing executions - comfortable operating upstream of campaigns and influencing how the broader org thinks about brand

  • Experience designing and managing brand health measurement programs (brand tracking, awareness, perception, brand lift) and translating findings into clear strategic action

  • Strong creative judgment, including experience writing compelling creative briefs, providing strategic guidance to creative agencies and in-house studios, and partnering with creative teams to develop standout work

  • Experience designing and running creative experimentation programs that improve campaign performance and feed back into brand strategy

  • Analytical rigor — comfortable planning and executing research with the help of internal or external research partners. Adept at synthesizing quantitative and qualitative data into insights, recommendations, and business cases

jobs.jobDescription:
We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. This role owns the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for one or more products within the Articulate platform, including the GTM plan against revenue goals and the commercial model behind it.

You will shape messaging, pricing and packaging, use funnel data and AI systems to sharpen the plan, and build the launch foundations for execution. You will partner with product, marketing, sales, customer success, growth, ops, and ecosystem and reseller partners to shape the roadmap and carry recommendations to senior leaders. We are looking for someone who writes the playbook, builds the systems the team runs on, and is accountable for the plan that delivers a revenue goal.

What you'll own:

  • Revenue and GTM plan. Own the GTM plan against the revenue goal for your product(s). Work with Sales and Ops on targets, track progress against them, and decide what to scale, fix, pause or stop as results come in.

  • Commercial model. Shape the pricing, packaging, and monetization approach for your product(s). Make recommendations and carry them through to a decision with cross-functional partners.

  • Shared context and systems. Build and maintain the positioning, messaging, and competitive context, plus the skills and workflows, that the PMM team and its AI agents run on.

  • Funnel data and insights. Own the funnel for your product(s), from first touch through conversion and expansion. Help shape the dashboards and metrics the team relies on, using them to turn insights into GTM strategy and execution.

  • Field readiness. Act as the voice of product, owning field messaging, FAQs, web content, and live enablement for Sales, Customer Success, and reseller partners.

What you'll do:

  • Build positioning, value propositions, and differentiated messaging for the full buying committee, from practitioners and business creators to administrators and IT stakeholders, and hold a high quality bar on what the team ships

  • Develop deep insight into customers, segments, and target accounts, and use research, usage data, and buying signals to guide GTM plans and the roadmap

  • Build the launch and campaign foundations (plans, templates, assets, standards) that Growth, Content, and Sales execute from

  • Work with Product and Engineering on the roadmap, and make the case for what to build next and how it should be priced and packaged

  • Work with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Marketing leadership to reach decisions on commercial strategy that cross teams

  • Adapt GTM across ecosystem, integration, and reseller partners as revenue channels, including positioning, co-marketing, enablement, and shared account plans

  • Build with AI every day - create workflows and agents for your own work, and add to the team's shared context, skills, and agents so everyone's output improves

  • Decide what to do yourself, what to delegate, and what to automate

  • Create internal and field assets, track competitors and market trends, and support events

What you should have:

  • 8+ years of product marketing experience, B2B SaaS preferred

  • A track record of owning a GTM plan against a revenue goal or other commercial outcome, and making calls on what to scale, fix, or stop based on data

  • Experience shaping pricing, packaging, and monetization, ideally including usage-based or credit-based models

  • Hands-on AI proficiency to speed up your work and apply your own judgment to the output

  • A high-quality bar for excellent storytelling with the ability to turn complex or technical ideas into a clear narrative that stands out

  • Experience owning a funnel, plus strong comfort with funnel metrics and dashboards used to shape messaging, strategy, and decisions

  • Experience building a launch or GTM framework from a blank page that others then adopted

  • Ability to operate in ambiguity, flex across shifting priorities, and execute in adjacent areas like Growth, Ops and even Sales

  • Experience with ecosystem, integration, or reseller partnerships, ideally as a revenue channel

  • Proven ability to make strategic recommendations to senior leaders and reach a decision

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration across product, sales, customer success, growth, operations, legal, and partners

  • Experience raising the bar for peers through templates, standards, or coaching

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, MBA preferred

  • Nice to have: experience with e-learning creation or delivery tools, including Articulate 360

Compensation

The pay range for this position is $129,900 - $172,144 for all US locations. This range represents our good faith expectation of what we reasonably expect to pay for this role based on factors including (but not limited to) skills, experience, training, licensure and certifications, education, and other business and organizational needs.

This position is bonus-eligible. Articulate also offers a robust suite of benefits — visit the website for a full list.

This is a US-based role and can be performed remotely from anywhere within the United States. Occasional travel for company events may be required. Employees must physically reside and work within the US throughout their employment and must immediately notify Articulate of any change of address.

The application window for this position is expected to close 90 days from the original posting date.

Additional Information

About us

Articulate Global, LLC, is the leading SaaS provider of creator platforms for online workplace training. Founded by Adam Schwartz in 2002, Articulate provides creator tools and services that make it simple for enterprises and SMBs to develop, deliver, and analyze online workplace training that’s engaging and effective. Increasingly, organizations must reskill employees for ever-changing remote and hybrid work environments, create learning cultures that attract and retain employees in a tight labor market, and use training to build more equitable, empowering, and engaging workplaces. Articulate helps organizations address these critical business needs with its creator platform for workplace training. Articulate 360—a suite of creator tools for online courses—was named the 7th most-loved product in the world by TrustRadius in 2021. And Rise—an all-in-one online training system that makes online training easy to create, enjoyable to take, and simple to manage—is the first creator platform for SMBs and departments within the enterprise. Articulate has more than 118,000 customers in 170 countries and counts all 100 of the Fortune 100 companies as customers.

Named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces 2022 and a leader in building a human-centered organization, Articulate is guided by a commitment to provide the best value to customers, do right by employees, and create an equitable, empowering workplace for all. As a human-centered organization, we honor people’s humanity knowing that each person’s unique history, vulnerabilities, and social location inform how we show up with one another. We embrace our connectedness, aware that what we do and say impacts others. We give each other grace because we are all works in progress, learning and evolving every day. And we take responsibility for ourselves and are serious about our accountability to each other. In all we do, we strive to create an equitable, sustainable, and empowering workplace while we drive results for the business and make a positive impact in the world. Read more about our values here.

Articulate Global, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All employment decisions at Articulate are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications directly related to the job, without regard to any protected characteristic or class, including, but not limited to, race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. Qualified candidates with criminal histories will be considered for this role in a manner consistent with applicable law. Articulate is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation related to the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@articulate.com.

(For information about Articulate's privacy practices, please view our Privacy Notice)

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Reseller Sales

Location: Remote - Candidate must be located in the Chicagoland area

Compensation Range: $200,000 to $225,000 OTE (60/40 split) plus equity

What You’ll Do

Huntress is looking for a National Reseller Sales Manager, CDW to join our reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing the CDW partnership across the United States to support Huntress’ continued growth and expansion.

You will use your knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape to open opportunities and leverage existing key relationships within CDW at the corporate and regional levels. This role will work closely with senior sales leaders and other stakeholders across the Huntress revenue organization to identify new CDW plays and programs, increase revenue, and expand Huntress’ market presence.

You will identify value-creation opportunities, shape partner plans, and support reseller execution and long-term success.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a national plan to grow Huntress mindshare within CDW, building awareness, preference, and understanding of Huntress across CDW’s relevant sales, partner, and leadership teams
  • Build and maintain relationships with CDW stakeholders nationally and across key regions, aligning on priorities, target customer segments, routes to market, and joint growth opportunities
  • Enable CDW teams to confidently position Huntress through role-based training, sales plays, product and competitive guidance, and easy-to-use partner resources
  • Create a consistent cadence of national and regional engagement with CDW, including business reviews, field alignment, partner events, and coordinated seller outreach
  • Work with CDW and Huntress marketing teams to plan and execute co-marketing campaigns, events, and other programs that increase awareness and generate qualified pipeline
  • Identify and activate opportunities to expand Huntress visibility across CDW’s relevant sales motions and customer touchpoints; track progress through engagement, enablement, pipeline, and revenue indicators
  • Coordinate with Huntress sales, channel, distribution, and marketing teams to ensure CDW receives a consistent experience and that national priorities translate into field execution
  • Create and execute a strategic plan to maximize sales through CDW, including sales targets, incentives, and marketing initiatives that drive CDW-sourced pipeline and closed revenue
  • Oversee CDW opportunity registration with Huntress to ensure proper attribution, deal protection, and margin allocation
  • Track CDW performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching and direction to maximize partner sales potential
  • Represent Huntress at CDW events, partner days, conferences, and other relevant activities
  • Bring real-time market, competitive, CDW, and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business

What You Bring to the Team

  • 7+ years of experience in channel sales, strategic account management, partner management, or distribution, with direct experience working at CDW or managing and growing a CDW relationship on behalf of a cybersecurity vendor
  • Strong understanding of CDW’s sales organization, partner ecosystem, and routes to market, with the ability to navigate national and regional stakeholders and turn relationships into coordinated field execution
  • A demonstrated track record of building executive and seller relationships at CDW, creating partner mindshare, and translating joint plans into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes
  • Experience developing and delivering partner enablement, sales plays, and co-marketing programs for a large solution provider or reseller
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including product categories, technical capabilities, and industry trends—particularly across SMB, Commercial, and SLED customer segments
  • Experience positioning cybersecurity solutions through channel partners; knowledge of Microsoft licensing and security solutions is highly preferred
  • A data-driven, accountable operator who can set priorities, manage a broad national relationship, and coordinate effectively across sales, marketing, distribution, and partner teams
  • A confident, credible communicator who can build trust with senior decision-makers and frontline sellers and foster long-term partnerships
  • Comfortable working remotely and managing a broad, nationwide territory
  • Willingness to travel across the United States as needed

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
  • 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
  • Life and Disability insurance plans
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
  • Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance
  • $75 USD/month digital reimbursement
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

jobs.jobDescription:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're hiring a Manager, Inside Sales to lead a team of 5-6 ISRs, coach them into strong closers, and help build this function from the ground up. You'll be a player-coach: close enough to the work to join calls and unblock deals, and accountable for the team's pipeline, bookings, and renewals.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise ISRs through regular one-on-ones, call reviews, deal coaching, and performance conversations.

  • Build individual development plans that strengthen discovery, business-value messaging, product demonstrations, negotiation, and closing.

  • Reinforce MEDDICC and Command of the Message at a level appropriate to each opportunity’s size and complexity

  • Run consistent pipeline reviews and maintain accurate forecasts

  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Enablement, Marketing, and Customer Success to improve routing, onboarding, handoffs, and expansion execution

  • Align the team with Field Account Executives so outbound prospecting, inbound follow-up, and event follow-up turn into pipeline

  • Hire, onboard, and ramp new reps; prepare top performers for progression into Field AE roles; and build a culture grounded in accountability, curiosity, collaboration, and ownership.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of SaaS or tech sales experience, including closing, with 1-2 years leading or formally mentoring reps (team lead, senior ISR/AE, or first-time manager ready to step up)

  • A track record of coaching reps to measurable improvement in pipeline, conversion, or attainment

  • Comfort running a data-driven sales cadence in a CRM (Salesforce or similar) and using forecasting and call-intelligence tools

  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication, and the credibility to coach through live deals

  • Experience working alongside field sales or account executives

  • Nice to have: experience selling to manufacturing, industrial, or maintenance audiences

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.jobDescription:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

About the Role

Demandbase is looking for a Senior Manager of Events to own high-impact event programs that bring our customers, prospects, partners, and GTM teams together. This role will lead the strategy and execution for user summits, trade shows, and field events that build Demandbase awareness, deepen customer relationships, and drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the strategy, planning, execution, and post-event optimization for Demandbase user summits, trade shows, and field events that support pipeline, customer engagement, and brand awareness goals. Use performance data and cross-functional leadership input to shape programs, stay hands-on through execution, and own results and ongoing improvements.

  • Build and manage the event plan for assigned portfolios, including event selection, sponsorship recommendations, audience strategy, budget planning, staffing model, onsite experience and post event plan.

  • Lead cross-functional planning with growth marketing, sales, customer success, partner marketing, product marketing, brand, creative, marketing operations, and executive stakeholders.

  • Translate company and GTM priorities into clear event objectives, success metrics, run-of-show documents, staffing plans, and follow-up motions.

  • Own event budgets for assigned programs, manage forecasts and actuals, negotiate with vendors, and identify trade-offs that improve attendee experience and business impact.

  • Lead event production and logistics across venue, registration, AV, booth design, sponsorship assets, speaker readiness, shipping, signage, swag, staffing, travel coordination, and onsite operations.

  • Set the standard for pre-event and post-event execution, including sales enablement, meeting generation, lead capture, lead handoff, and event follow-up.

  • Create post-event readouts that connect event investment to attendance, engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, customer impact, learnings, and recommendations.

  • Develop scalable event playbooks, project plans, templates, vendor practices, and process improvements that help the events team operate more consistently.

  • Guide supporting team members, contractors, and agency partners by breaking complex programs into clear workstreams, assigning ownership, and removing roadblocks.

  • Directly source and evaluate hotels, event venues, and experience providers, lead vendor negotiations, and coordinate contract review to secure favorable rates and terms aligned with event goals, budgets, and attendee needs.

  • Lead end-to-end event production, coordinating internal teams and external partners such as fabrication, AV, venue operations, signage, staging, logistics, and on-site execution vendors for large-scale events.

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B event marketing experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, ABM, martech, or another high-growth B2B environment.

  • Proven experience owning complex events end to end, including user conferences or summits, trade shows, executive programs, customer events, and regional field events.

  • Strong business judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous situations with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and changing timelines.

  • Demonstrated budget ownership, vendor negotiation, project management, and onsite leadership across multiple simultaneous events.

  • Revenue-focused mindset with experience partnering with sales and marketing operations to define goals, capture leads, support follow-up, and measure pipeline impact.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, sales leaders, customers, partners, vendors, and internal collaborators.

  • Experience improving event processes, reporting, templates, or operating rhythms so programs become more repeatable and scalable.

  • Hands-on fluency with tools such as Salesforce, marketing automation, Asana, Bizzabo, ON24, or similar event and project management platforms.

  • Ability to travel for events and support occasional evening or weekend programs as needed.

Benefits

Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long-term financial well-being.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

We are looking for an SEO Manager to join our growing team at Wpromote! Our ideal candidate will have a passion for establishing strong relationships with their clients, a natural curiosity for website optimization, and a knack for being proactive in pursuing growth opportunities for their book of business. You will work with a group of amazing SEO team members that you are able to learn from and bounce ideas off of. Read on, if this sounds like your next challenge!

You Will Be

  • Working on multiple client websites and digital ecosystems by implementing changes across technical SEO, content, and AI search optimization in order to comply with evolving search engine and AI platform best practices.

  • Optimizing for visibility across both traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and AI-driven discovery platforms (e.g., generative engines, assistants, and answer engines).

  • Owning client retention and proactively identifying profitable growth opportunities across assigned accounts.

  • Building strong client relationships through consistent communication, including virtual meetings, email, and ongoing strategic discussions.

  • Strategizing with team members to develop integrated SEO and AI Search solutions that drive discoverability, authority, and performance.

  • Staying current on developments across SEO and AI Search, including industry trends, algorithm updates, LLM advancements, and competitive activity.

  • Creating reports and dashboards to gauge performance across rankings, traffic, and AI-driven visibility, and to demonstrate business impact.

  • Presenting insights and strategic recommendations to clients to help shape their content, technical SEO, and AI Search strategies.

  • Supporting new business and organic growth opportunities by contributing SEO expertise to solution development, proposals, and cross-functional sales efforts.

  • Working with a client’s development, content, and product teams to implement changes to their website and digital presence, including structured data, content systems, and AI-readable formats.

You Must Have

  • 2-3 years experience doing SEO work for clients within an agency environment

  • Minimum 1 year of client facing experience

  • Desire to lead strategy for multiple large growth SEO and AI Search clients

  • Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals including keyword research, search intent, technical SEO, and website architecture

  • Familiarity with how AI search systems (e.g., LLMs, generative engines) retrieve, interpret, and surface content

  • Experience with keyword research, competitive analysis, and emerging AI search tools

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, and performance measurement across both traditional and AI-driven search environments

  • Understanding of content strategy, including entity-based optimization, topical authority, and structured data

  • Experience working directly on websites (general knowledge of CMS such as WordPress, Shopify, or Magento is a plus)

  • Ability to quickly pick up new skills and adapt to a rapidly evolving search landscape

  • Excellent multi-tasking skills with the ability to hit and exceed deadlines required

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral while paying close attention to detail

  • A proactive approach to collaborating with others and managing workload

Compensation

Additional Information

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

  • Remote-first culture
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Extended Holiday break (Winter)
  • Flexible schedules
  • Work from anywhere options*
  • 100% paid parental leave
  • 401(k) matching
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
  • Sponsored life insurance
  • Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
  • Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $69,000 - 80,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Senior Account Executive

Instructure, Inc. is seeking a Senior Account Executive to drive revenue growth and expand relationships with key clients in the BizGov sector. In this role, you will focus on strategic sales initiatives and play a crucial part in growing Instructure's presence within your assigned territory or market segment.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies to achieve and exceed sales quotas

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling Instructure’s suite of products (such as Canvas, MasteryConnect, and Elevate)

  • Prospect and qualify new business opportunities

  • Conduct presentations and product demonstrations to C-level executives and key stakeholders

  • Negotiate and close complex contracts, ensuring alignment with company and customer needs

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure a seamless customer experience

  • Provide accurate sales forecasting and manage your pipeline using CRM tools

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Instructure products

  • Represent Instructure at industry events and conferences

What you will need to know/have:

  • 5+ years of successful experience in enterprise software sales

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas

  • Experience managing full sales cycles—from prospecting to closing

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Proficiency with CRM software (such as Salesforce) and sales productivity tools

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Willingness to travel up to 50%

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

Wpromote is looking for an ambitious, experienced, and self-motivated Manager, Performance Creative to join our growing Performance Creative team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the fast-paced environment of an agency and is passionate about developing high-performing creative across a variety of digital channels alongside a collaborative and innovative team. Reporting to an Associate Director, this individual will own the development and execution of performance-driven creative across a portfolio of clients, partnering closely with Digital and Motion Designers as well as internal paid media teams.

As a Manager, Performance Creative, you will help shape creative strategy through data-informed testing, iteration, and scalable concepts designed to drive measurable growth across the funnel. This role extends beyond asset creation, requiring a strong understanding of channel dynamics, testing frameworks, and client KPIs to ensure creative performance aligns with broader business objectives.

You Will Be

  • Owning the strategy, direction, and delivery of performance-driven creative across a book of business ranging from 2-5 clients, ensuring alignment with client KPIs and channel objectives
  • Translating performance data into clear creative direction, including testing roadmaps, hypotheses, and iteration plans
  • Developing recurring static and video briefs grounded in platform best practices and performance insights. Inclusive of performance-driven messaging, hooks, headlines, and ad copy tailored to platform behavior, audience insights, and campaign objectives
  • Partnering closely with Media teams to align on testing strategy, scaling opportunities, and performance optimization
  • Collaborating with Design and Production to bring concepts to life, managing timelines, budgets, and deliverables
  • Analyzing creative performance across platforms and synthesize learnings into actionable insights and next steps
  • Applying a strong understanding of platform dynamics (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Programmatic) to inform creative strategy
  • Supporting client communication by presenting creative concepts, performance insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Contributing to the development of creative testing frameworks, best practices, and ways of working across accounts
  • Identifying opportunities to improve creative efficiency through tools, automation, and emerging technologies
  • Traveling occasionally to visit clients, team meetings, and/or events. Likely 1-3 times/year

You Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience in performance creative, paid social, or a related field, preferably within an agency environment
  • 2+ years of experience owning client relationships and delivering creative tied to performance outcomes
  • A strong understanding of how creative and media work together, with experience partnering with media teams on testing, scaling, and optimization strategies
  • Experience translating performance data into actionable creative direction, taxonomy, testing hypotheses, and iteration plans
  • Working knowledge of paid media platforms, especially Meta Ads Manager, with familiarity across TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, and emerging channels
  • Strong creative and performance marketing instincts, with the ability to develop and iterate on messaging, hooks, headlines, and ad copy that resonate across audiences, platforms, and funnel stages to drive engagement and conversion
  • Ability to identify which creative concepts to scale, iterate on, or pivot from based on performance insights
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with experience managing multiple timelines, deliverables, and workstreams simultaneously
  • Strong client-facing communication skills, including presenting creative work, performance insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Strong awareness of emerging trends, platform evolution, and culturally relevant moments, with a proactive approach to staying current on shifts shaping consumer behavior and creative best practices
  • Actively explores and leverages AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance creative development, optimize workflows, and drive operational efficiency
  • A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally across Media, Design, Production, and Client Strategy teams

What We Offer

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Role

We're looking for a Performance Marketing & Marketing Operations Manager to drive paid media performance and manage the marketing systems that support our growth.

Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation, you'll own campaign execution, budget optimization, and HubSpot operations, helping us reach AI research labs and enterprise AI teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning marketing strategies into measurable pipeline, improving processes, and using data to make smarter decisions.

Your Impact

  • Own and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, X Ads, and account-based marketing (ABM) programs.
  • Manage paid media budgets, including allocation, pacing, and performance against pipeline goals.
  • Build targeted and retargeting audiences using account insights and intent data to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitor cost per lead (CPL), cost per sales-qualified lead (SQL), and pipeline contribution through ongoing A/B testing and performance reporting.
  • Manage HubSpot operations, including workflows, forms, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and marketing automation.
  • Improve lead routing, Sales handoffs, and data quality to support a more efficient conversion process.
  • Maintain UTM tracking standards and build attribution models and full-funnel dashboards that provide actionable insights to leadership.
  • Oversee marketing technology integrations and ensure email marketing compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CASL.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to improve campaign performance, lead management, and reporting accuracy.

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in B2B performance marketing and marketing operations, ideally in a technology or SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on expertise with LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, including campaign management, optimization, and budget ownership.
  • Strong HubSpot administration skills, including marketing automation, lead scoring, workflows, and lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM), intent data, and audience segmentation.
  • Proven ability to analyze marketing performance, build attribution models, and report on funnel and pipeline metrics.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve everyday marketing workflows, efficiency, and campaign execution.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.
  • A proactive, results-oriented approach with a willingness to test, learn, and continuously improve.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in AI, machine learning, data, or related technology industries.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce administration or CRM integrations.
  • Knowledge of SQL or business intelligence tools such as Looker Studio or Tableau.
  • HubSpot, Google Ads, or LinkedIn Marketing certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you'll have taken ownership of our paid media programs, identified opportunities to improve campaign performance, and strengthened our marketing operations.

You'll establish clear performance benchmarks, improve lead routing and scoring, and deliver reporting dashboards that Marketing and Sales can rely on. Success means maintaining paid media spend within the plan, reducing cost per SQL, and building a more reliable view of marketing's contribution to pipeline.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

Compensation

Additional Information

CrossFit is seeking a Partner Programs Manager, EDU. You will own the business relationships and contractual performance of CrossFit Education partners. This role leads partner negotiations, contract management, onboarding, ongoing relationship management, renewals, and exits. The Partner Programs Manager works cross-functionally to ensure that obligations are met, partner programs perform against plan, and issues are addressed promptly.

Responsibilities

Contracts and Negotiation:

  • Develop and drive the completion of partner agreements in collaboration with EDU leadership and Legal.
  • Track commitments covering fees or revenue share, course delivery, cancellations, reporting, marketing, and use of CrossFit trademarks.
  • Manage contract amendments, renewals, and partner exits.

Partner Relationship Management:

  • Serve as the primary EDU contact throughout partner engagement, onboarding, ongoing operations, renewal, or exit.
  • Maintain strong partner relationships, resolve concerns, and establish regular business reviews and operational touchpoints.

Contract Delivery and Compliance:

  • Coordinate CrossFit obligations with EDU Operations, Analytics, Product, Content, Marketing, Finance, and Legal.
  • Track partner commitments, including course schedule changes, reporting, participant feedback, promotional obligations, and payments.
  • Escalate unmet obligations and coordinate corrective action or exit when needed.

Standards and Participant Feedback:

  • Implement participant surveys for partner courses; monitor and report NPS, feedback trends, and corrective action plans.
  • Periodically review partner websites and platforms for appropriate use of CrossFit names, marks, and standards.
  • Refer content quality concerns to the EDU Content Manager for review and resolution.

Program Performance and Reporting:

  • Track registrations, revenue, course volume, renewals, and overall partnership performance with EDU Finance and Analytics.
  • Identify performance gaps, recommend improvements, and maintain centralized records of agreements, obligations, contacts, metrics, and renewal dates.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong contract negotiation, commercial judgment, and partner relationship management skills.
  • Ability to translate agreement terms into clear obligations, milestones, and performance measures.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, issue resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Comfort analyzing partner economics, registrations, revenue, renewals, and participant satisfaction data.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple partners and deadlines.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and manage sensitive partner issues professionally.
  • Working knowledge of partner operations, trademark/brand compliance, and contract lifecycle processes.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, education, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management, vendor management, or contract administration.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating agreements and managing external partner relationships from onboarding through renewal.
  • Experience tracking contractual obligations, program performance, and partner satisfaction.
  • Experience in education, professional learning, certification, licensing, or a related partner-delivered program environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with the CrossFit ecosystem and educational programs. CrossFit Level 1 or higher trainer credential preferred.

Compensation

Additional Information

This is a hands-on role: build campaign strategy, execute high-quality activations, optimize to business KPIs, and partner with cross-functional counterparts such as Creative leads to test social-first creative as well as Data Science leads to operationalize modern measurement. We’re looking for someone who’s dedicated to cultivating curiosity, operates with a learning mindset, and is passionate about driving results while having fun along the way. If we could describe an ideal candidate for this role, words like analytical, strategic, proactive, collaborative, conversion-focused, and creative come to mind.

You Will Be

  • Formulate full-funnel paid social strategies that tie media decisions to client business objectives (e.g., revenue growth, CPA, LTV, lead generation, brand awareness).
  • Own day-to-day campaign setup, activation, and optimization across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, Pinterest, X, Nextdoor, and other relevant channels.
  • Lead client communications for assigned accounts (with Director support), including weekly reporting, optimization rationale, and recommended next steps.
  • Translate creative insights into testable hypotheses and partner closely with Creative leads (in-house teams, Wpromote creative retainers, or third-party agencies) to iterate on social-first creative assets and sequencing.
  • Design and run experiments and A/B tests, capture learnings, and scale winning tactics; track experiment velocity and ensure insights are documented.
  • Apply strict QA, tagging, and tracking discipline to ensure accurate delivery and measurement integrity.
  • Build and maintain measurement-accurate setups, including platform pixel tagging, server-to-server integrations (CAPI/SDK where applicable), and first-party signal capture; leverage tools such as Events Manager and Pixel Helper to identify and escalate gaps to senior measurement partners.
  • Participate in cross-functional pod workflows (Creative, Data Strategy, Paid Search, Programmatic) and execute against shared KPIs.

You Must Have

  • 2–3+ years of paid media experience (paid social, paid search, and/or media buying) in an agency or in-house/client environment.
  • Hands-on experience building, optimizing, analyzing, and reporting on paid social campaigns across Meta and at least one additional platform (e.g., TikTok, Snap, Reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn, X, Nextdoor, Google).
  • Strong operational fluency with Meta Ads Manager and other platform UIs; comfortable exporting, analyzing, and manipulating campaign data.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics / GA4 (or tools such as Northbeam, Adobe, TripleWhale, etc.) for basic cross-channel and assist analysis.
  • Solid skills in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Highly detail-oriented, with strong QA habits and a bias toward documenting processes and results.
  • Facebook Blueprint certification preferred.

Nice To Have

  • Experience leveraging Smartly.
  • Basic SQL skills and/or experience working with BI tools.

jobs.jobDescription:
Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team - West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

  1. Own the revenue outcomes for the segment, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large-scale competitive replacement deals.

  2. Build a high caliber team in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.

  3. Establish a reputation for excellence by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering & Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.

In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You could be a great fit if:

  • You’ve led and scaled a team of SaaS Enterprise Account Executives delivering $5M/yr+ at a company that has scaled beyond $100M ARR

  • You have helped win $1M+ SaaS deals with publicly traded companies, and can help your team see around corners on complex deals

  • You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding Ent AEs who can create their own pipeline and close both more tactical ($100k) and strategic ($500k+) deals

  • You have a strong mental model for enterprise sales execution. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.

  • You build trusted relationships with customers and confidently facilitate peer-to-peer conversations between senior leaders to deepen partnerships and elevate strategic engagements.

  • You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.

  • ⚙️ You have successfully sold a complex multi-product platform and have won competitive rip-and-replace sales motions.

Bonus

  • You have sold to Talent and/or People leaders and are familiar with their pains and priorities

You shouldn't apply if:

  • You're a dashboard-and-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations

  • You're not keen on learning our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby

  • We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals

  • We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience

  • We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Enterprise segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

  1. Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.

  2. Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today.

  3. Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with pipeline data and seek your perspective on the segment. You'll discuss your approach to hiring, coaching and sales execution.

  4. Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional leaders

Benefits

  • A product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about

  • Competitive salary, commission and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
