You will serve as a senior strategic partner to clients, bringing deep experience in digital marketing, lead generation, and customer acquisition across long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying journeys.…
jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

Wpromote is looking for a Group Account Director to lead the growth, retention, and strategic direction of some of our largest B2B client relationships. You will serve as a senior strategic partner to clients, bringing deep experience in digital marketing, lead generation, and customer acquisition across long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying journeys.

Reporting into the Head of B2B Client Delivery, you will oversee a portfolio of complex B2B accounts while guiding the account teams responsible for their success. You will develop trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, translate business and marketing objectives into integrated strategies, and ensure Wpromote delivers measurable value across every engagement. This role will also be responsible for identifying organic growth opportunities, managing account health and profitability, and developing account leaders across SaaS, professional services, and enterprise clients.

You Will Be

  • Serving as the senior relationship leader and escalation point across a portfolio of complex B2B client accounts
  • Building trusted partnerships with VP and C-suite client stakeholders and advising them on business, marketing, and growth priorities
  • Overseeing the growth, retention, strategic direction, and overall health of assigned client relationships
  • Identifying and advancing organic growth opportunities across existing accounts while supporting broader new business efforts
  • Developing a deep understanding of each client’s business, category, market, buying committee, competitive landscape, and ideal customer profile (ICP)
  • Bringing strategic and innovative ideas to client engagements by partnering with Wpromote specialists and applying a strong understanding of cross-channel marketing dynamics
  • Guiding the development of integrated, full-funnel marketing strategies across channels such as Paid Search, Organic Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, YouTube, Email, and Content
  • Overseeing all aspects of client statements of work, including deliverables, renewals, scope changes, and change orders
  • Leading executive-level client meetings, quarterly business reviews, annual planning sessions, and other strategic conversations
  • Interpreting data from analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms such as GA4, Salesforce, 6sense, Demandbase, Marketo, Pardot, and HubSpot to assess performance and identify opportunities to drive pipeline and revenue growth
  • Ensuring marketing strategies align with client goals, sales priorities, and measurable business outcomes
  • Managing the financial health and profitability of assigned accounts, including staffing, resource allocation, agency hours, forecasting, and scope management
  • Collaborating with Strategy, Creative, Media, Analytics, and Martech teams to deliver cohesive campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Providing strategic oversight and quality control across client deliverables
  • Anticipating account risks and developing proactive plans to protect client relationships, retention, and business performance
  • Leading, developing, and motivating Account Directors and other account team members while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continued growth
  • Helping improve account management processes, standards, and best practices across Wpromote’s B2B practice

You Must Have

  • 10-12+ years experience managing client relationships across SaaS, professional services, or other complex solution categories in an agency environment
  • 5-6+ years of B2B client management experience
  • Experience overseeing a portfolio of complex, enterprise-sized client relationships and guiding multiple account teams
  • A demonstrated track record of strengthening client relationships, retaining business, and identifying organic growth opportunities
  • Experience developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies across Paid Search, Organic Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, Email, Content, and other relevant channels
  • Experience leading full-funnel digital programs spanning awareness, demand generation, lead nurturing, pipeline acceleration, and sales enablement
  • A strong understanding of B2B sales cycles, buying committees, and funnel stages from MQA through closed-won, with the ability to align marketing programs with revenue KPIs
  • Experience leveraging CRM, marketing automation, and intent data platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, 6sense, and Demandbase to inform strategy and reporting
  • The ability to translate complex media, attribution, and business performance data into clear insights and recommendations for VP and C-suite stakeholders
  • Strong strategic marketing capabilities, including competitive assessments, industry analysis, audience segmentation, and go-to-market planning
  • Experience successfully overseeing multiple enterprise-sized clients with combined media budgets exceeding $80 million
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience managing account profitability, scopes of work, staffing plans, and resource allocation
  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing account leaders and cross-functional teams
  • The ability to foster collaboration and influence teams across disciplines without direct authority
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management skills
  • The ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams and perform effectively under pressure
  • An energetic, solutions-oriented approach and passion for client leadership
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with multi-touch attribution and media mix modeling
  • Experience supporting enterprise new business pitches and RFP responses
  • Experience helping scale account management processes or capabilities within a growing B2B practice

Compensation

Additional Information

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $140,000 - $165,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

jobs.jobDescription:
Joining Collibra’s Public Sector team

Make an impact at Collibra Public Sector by driving growth in US federal DOW agencies. This role will be responsible for selling Collibra's value and vision to prospects and existing customers, offering a complete solution that includes software, support and services. As part of our federal sales team, you will manage some of Collibra’s largest accounts. You will use your knowledge and skills in enterprise sales to establish trusted and credible relationships, build Collibra’s brand and awareness around our solutions, and serve as a data intelligence advisor throughout the customer journey. You will be actively involved in the entire sales cycle creating initial demand, progressing the opportunity through the technical and financial decision process, and ensuring adoption and expansion after the sale.

Collibra Public Sector Account Executive II, Federal at Collibra are responsible for

  • 5+ years in a technical customer facing role, ideally supporting Enterprise Class customers in an SaaS environment.
  • Experience in Technical Account Management, Support or similar type of Premium or Signature Service organization dealing with Enterprise Software Application Support.
  • Experience troubleshooting web-based applications.
  • Experience with Java, REST API and SSO and a working knowledge of kubernetes, with VM, SQL, SSL, SSO, and LDAP a plus.
  • Experience and a strong interest in developing deep customer relationships while facilitating discussions about enterprise IT architecture.

You have

  • Consistently exceeded assigned sales quotas.
  • Experience in the data storage or data management software industry.
  • 7 + years experience calling on federal defense accounts in a field sales capacity.
  • Prior relationships with Departments of Defense/War, Army, Fourth Estate.
  • Originated and closed complex sales with multiple technical and business stakeholders.
  • Managed consultative sales processes, with value-based impacts or outcomes.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience.
  • US citizenship (required) and active security clearance (preferred).
  • Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
  • Because this role supports the US government, it is required that this candidate be a US citizen who resides on US soil.

You are

  • Known for your integrity, and commitment to the customer.
  • Detail and results oriented – you work backwards from a goal using documented plans.
  • Composed, resourceful, and comfortable in high-growth high-expectation environments.
  • Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented.
  • A concise communicator, persuasive negotiator, collaborative seller.
  • Proud of your work and aim for excellence.
  • Flexible to travel as required.

Measures of success

  • Within your first month, you will have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers.
  • Within your third month, you will be building a pipeline of business in your assigned territory.
  • Within your sixth month, you will have solid foundation of prospective clients who you will be close to closing.

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. jobs.jobDescription:
LOCATION:

The Senior Growth Manager is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required, for client meetings or other internal meetings, conferences, etc.

THE ROLE:

Acceleration Partners is seeking a Senior Growth Manager to drive partner growth strategies for some of our largest and most complex client programs. In this role, you will identify, develop, and scale high-impact partnerships that drive measurable revenue growth and help clients achieve their business objectives. You will shape recruitment, activation, and optimization strategies, uncover emerging growth opportunities, and influence partnership roadmaps beyond traditional affiliate models.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Revenue:

  • Publisher & Partner Performance: Contributes to client growth and retention by building high-potential partner relationships and optimizing performance. Prioritizes the client’s most strategically important partner relationships and is trusted to make judgment calls on where to invest time without needing direction.
  • Performance Trackers & Reporting: Follows client-approved processes for paid placements and partner optimizations. Uses reporting effectively, translating data into a clear story that shows clients not just what happened, but why it matters and what to do next. Often defines or improves that process rather than just following it.
  • Subject Matter Expert Across the Partnership Landscape: Is a trusted, knowledgeable resource on partner relationships and client verticals. Recognized as an SME not just on their own accounts but across the department.

Business Development and Publisher Relationships:

  • Proactive Research: Identifies and recruits high-quality partners with strong revenue potential. Regularly pursues more complex, or non-traditional partnership opportunities independently.
  • Written and Verbal Communication: Communications are clear, informative, and engaging.
  • Initiative: Proactively identifies and executes areas of opportunity and optimization to drive revenue growth. Leads end-to-end negotiations with an appropriate level of autonomy and collaboration.

  Top Partner Management

  • Relationship Management: Optimizes opportunities with top partners on behalf of the client. [Senior] Manages the most strategically important and/or highest-value partner relationships in the portfolio and negotiates complex terms independently.
  • Budget Management: Identifies and acts on opportunities that drive client growth while maintaining a healthy return on investment. Operates with wider latitude on ROI trade-off decisions given demonstrated judgment.
  • Time Management: Demonstrates exceptional calendar and time management skills.

Strategy and Execution:

  • Alignment to Client Strategy and Goals: Participates in engagement kickoff calls and ongoing calls as needed; maintains a clear understanding of client goals and KPIs.
  • Creation and Ongoing Ownership of Partner Strategy: Builds a recruitment and/or paid placement plan end-to-end, based on client goals and KPIs. Independently owns this process and often shapes the process/best practices other Growth Managers follow.
  • Strategy Pivots: Adapts and pivots strategies to reach client goals. Trusted to reset client expectations directly, including navigating difficult conversations, without requiring senior support at each step.
  • Internal Support & Mentorship: Collaborates with the Senior Account Manager and Program Director on upskilling around partner recruitment and optimization. Provides hands-on, direct support to team members on publisher best practices, and in some cases builds their knowledge of specific verticals or sectors.

  Pitching Opportunities:

  • Client Education and Alignment: Clearly articulates the “why” behind each opportunity and its expected value, including anticipated ROI.
  • Persuasiveness: Regularly develops and delivers persuasive pitches that secure larger or less conventional opportunities.
  • Partnership Ecosystem Knowledge: Maintains deep knowledge across partnership types. Recognized expertise others actively seek out.
  • Tenacity: Has a track record of overcoming objections. Coaches other Growth Managers on how to handle rejection productively.

By 6 Months

You've established yourself as a trusted strategic advisor to clients and built strong relationships with key partners across the affiliate ecosystem. You possess a deep understanding of client objectives, growth opportunities, and emerging partner models, allowing you to proactively shape recruitment and partnership strategies rather than simply execute against them. You consistently identify, evaluate, and activate high-impact partnership opportunities that drive measurable revenue and incremental growth. Your insights and market expertise help clients stay ahead of industry trends, and you are regularly sought out for recommendations on how to evolve their partnership mix and growth strategy.

By 1 Year

You're recognized as a subject matter expert and growth leader, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue and recruitment goals across your portfolio. You have developed scalable processes, frameworks, and best practices that improve team performance. Through a combination of strategic partner development, innovative activation planning, and strong cross-functional collaboration, you drive significant client growth and help shape long-term partnership roadmaps. You are known for uncovering new and emerging partner opportunities, successfully expanding clients into non-traditional partnership models, and delivering growth initiatives that create lasting business impact for both clients and AP.

QUALITIES OF THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

  • Growth-oriented and energized by identifying, pursuing, and closing new opportunities, equally motivated to find new partnerships and deepen existing ones, with a proven track record.
  • Natural relationship builder who proactively creates opportunities and strengthens relationships for clients and partners.
  • Enjoys building persuasive, data-grounded pitches for opportunities that aren’t obvious or conventional.
  • Strong aptitude for shaping partner strategy independently, without needing a playbook handed to them.
  • Self-starter who pursues opportunities of every size and complexity, and follows through without needing to be chased.
  • Builds trust fast, with partners, clients, and internal stakeholders, even in ambiguous or high-stakes situations.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a remote environment, exercising sound judgment with minimal oversight.
  • Communicates with confidence, poise, and clarity in front of client leadership and in high-stakes moments.
  • Exercises mature, independent judgment on when to escalate versus solve it themselves, and is trusted to get that call right.

Minimum Qualifications & Skills

  • 5–8 years of partnership/channel marketing experience. Affiliate marketing background required; direct exposure to creator partnerships, AEO, or retail media is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of independently closing larger or more complex deals, not just managing existing relationships.
  • Proven excellence in consistently meeting or exceeding revenue/recruitment targets at a senior level.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including experience presenting to clients.
  • Knowledge of affiliate networks, including Impact, Partnerize, CJ, and Awin.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for client meetings, industry conferences, and events

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!
  • Target Salary is $80,000 - $95,000 depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

 

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-JC2

About the Role

Are you a tech-savvy storyteller ready to lead the charge in Veeam’s data protection revolution? As a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Veeam Data Platform, you’ll transform complex technology into compelling, benefits-driven content. Your expertise across virtualization, cloud, enterprise applications, databases, HCI, security, governance, storage, and beyond will allow you to forge deep connections with technical audiences and ICPs. Join us to craft narratives that highlight Veeam’s innovation and values, resonating with both new prospects and loyal customers alike!

Your responsibilities will include leading the Veeam Data Platform outreach strategy, supporting campaigns with engaging demos, videos, and webinars, and working closely with Product Management, Strategy and Marketing to develop messaging for cutting-edge features. Your content will simplify complex tech concepts into easy-to-understand, actionable benefits, helping Veeam stand out in a competitive landscape.

Be the definitive voice of Product Marketing, bridging the gap between tech and value for customers, partners, and sales teams. Be capable of articulating Data Resiliency benefits to Execs and Practitioners alike. If you’re strategic, customer-focused, and passionate about bringing technical stories to life—this is your next career move.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and develop the product outreach, web and content strategy for Veeam Data Platform for customer acquisition and expansion.
  • Manage the lifecycle of all related assets, ensuring accuracy and relevance.
  • Be the resource, comfortable with working in the product capable of explaining realizable benefits on in a customer digestible story
  • Collaborate with product management and product strategy team to understand the values and craft compelling content for the latest Veeam innovations.
  • Design and support campaigns using technical know-how to create interactive Storylane/dynamic demos, presenter-led demos, technical videos, and webinars.
  • Develop and execute launch assets for new technologies and support.
  • Simplify technical benefits to resonate with end-users and partners, captivating prospects and maintaining loyal customers.
  • Partner with the PMM team to refine Veeam’s market positioning, tapping into your knowledge of competitive landscapes and buyer personas.
  • Build and apply deep proficiency in Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), buyer personas, and key use cases to sharpen messaging, targeting, and content strategy for a deeply technical product.

Technologies You’ll Work With

  • Veeam Data Platform
  • Virtualization technologies
  • Cloud platforms
  • Enterprise applications
  • Databases
  • Hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)
  • Security and governance technologies
  • Storylane and dynamic demo platforms
  • Webinar and video platforms
  • Salesforce and commercial technology ecosystems
  • AI-enabled productivity and automation tools

What You’ll Bring

  • 5-10 years in B2B software roles (technical sales, sales engineering, product marketing, or product management); backup, recovery, security, or monitoring experience preferred. Being Tech Savvy is necessary.
  • Strong business acumen, able to convey complex concepts as business value; experience with software, cloud, or aaS delivery is a plus.
  • Proficient in managing pipeline day-to-day, working closely with Campaigns, Marketing Operations, and Analytics teams, and identifying remediation when campaigns and sales flag signs of underperformance.
  • Skilled storyteller with the ability to communicate compelling technical visions, verbally and in writing, to drive business results.
  • Comfortable presenting product use cases to technical non-technical personas
  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on setting and improving metrics, KPIs, and impact.
  • Innovative thinker who challenges norms, experiments with new ideas, and drives market and mindshare growth.
  • Proactive leader capable of managing multiple projects autonomously and building new initiatives in a dynamic environment.
  • Collaborative team player who fosters alignment and executes on shared goals.
  • Customer-focused, prioritizing the entire customer journey.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or related field
  • Comfortable in a remote, global team environment; willing to travel up to 15%.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE)

Zone 1: San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Boroughs

$211,440—$392,760 USD

Zone 2: Washington, California (excluding San Francisco Bay Area)

$193,820—$360,030 USD

Zone 3: Texas, Illinois, North Carolina, Colorado, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Oregon, Nevada, Hawaii, New York (excluding NYC boroughs); Sales roles located in Georgia, Ohio, and Arizona

$176,200—$327,300 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
LOCATION:

The Growth Manager is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required, for client meetings or other internal meetings, conferences, etc.

THE ROLE:

Acceleration Partners is seeking a Growth Manager to drive partner growth strategies for some of our largest and most complex client programs. In this role, you will identify, develop, and scale high-impact partnerships that drive measurable revenue growth and help clients achieve their business objectives. You will shape recruitment, activation, and optimization strategies, uncover emerging growth opportunities, and influence partnership roadmaps beyond traditional affiliate models.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Revenue:

  • Publisher & Partner Performance: Contributes to client growth and retention by building high-potential partner relationships and optimizing performance.
  • Performance Trackers & Reporting: Follows client-approved processes for paid placements and partner optimizations. Uses reporting effectively, translating data into a clear story that shows clients not just what happened, but why it matters and what to do next.
  • Subject Matter Expert Across the Partnership Landscape: Is a trusted, knowledgeable resource on partner relationships and client verticals. Proactively leads conversations to share insights, adding value to the accounts they support and the broader department.

Business Development and Partner Relationships:

  • Proactive Research: Identifies and recruits high-quality partners with strong revenue potential based on client needs.
  • Written and Verbal Communication: Communications are clear, informative, and engaging. Asks relevant questions to vet opportunities effectively. Manages day-to-day communication with top partners in the program.
  • Initiative: Proactively identifies and executes areas of opportunity and optimization across the program to drive revenue growth.

  Top Partner Management

  • Relationship Management: Optimizes opportunities with top partners on behalf of the client. Views themselves as a true extension of the client's business and maintains long-lasting relationships with key partners.
  • Budget Management: Identifies and acts on opportunities that drive client growth while maintaining a healthy return on investment.
  • Time Management: Demonstrates exceptional calendar and time management skills.

Strategy and Execution:

  • Alignment to Client Strategy and Goals: Participates in engagement kickoff calls and ongoing calls as needed; maintains a clear understanding of client goals and KPIs.
  • Creation and Ongoing Ownership of Partner Strategy: Builds a recruitment and/or paid placement plan end-to-end (from strategy through execution) based on client goals and KPIs.
  • Strategy Pivots: Adapts and pivots strategies to reach client goals, resetting expectations when needed. Pushes back constructively on unrealistic client goals while preserving trust.

 

Pitching Opportunities:

  • Client Education and Alignment: Clearly articulates the "why" behind each opportunity and its expected value, including anticipated ROI.
  • Persuasiveness: Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a willingness to challenge the status quo. Regularly identifies, pitches, and secures approval for innovative opportunities, grounded in data.
  • Partnership Ecosystem Knowledge: Maintains deep knowledge across partnership types and applies that expertise to confidently address client questions and identify opportunities.
  • Tenacity: Proactively explores the reasoning behind a rejection, thoughtfully pushes back when appropriate, and has a track record of overcoming objections.

What Success Looks Like

By 6 Months: You've developed strong relationships with your clients and their key partners, and have a firm grasp on the recruitment and reporting process. You're consistently sourcing and engaging partners who can drive real revenue and scale for your programs, meeting partner outreach goals as well as recruitment and revenue goals. You regularly bring relevant new partner opportunities to your clients and help keep AP on the forefront of affiliate publisher and partner models. Clients see you as someone who brings ideas, not just executes on them.

By 1 Year: You're consistently meeting or exceeding your goals and have established efficient reporting and recruitment processes, along with best practices that benefit the broader team. You've built a reputation for identifying opportunities that drive considerable revenue growth and for collaborating with partners and clients to develop new activation tactics that help clients exceed their goals. You've also successfully identified and activated non-traditional partner types for your clients.

Qualities of the ideal candidate:

  • Growth-oriented and energized by identifying, pursuing, and closing new opportunities, equally motivated to find new partnerships and deepen existing ones.
  • Natural relationship builder who proactively creates opportunities and strengthens relationships for clients and partners.
  • Enjoys building persuasive, data-grounded pitches that connect new opportunities directly to client goals.
  • Strong aptitude for developing partner strategy informed by publisher business models and client objectives.
  • Builds new relationships quickly and establishes credibility fast with clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a remote environment, exercising sound judgment with minimal oversight.
  • Communicates with confidence, poise, and clarity, especially under pressure or in high-stakes conversations.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment and brings their own structure and prioritization to it.
  • Exercises mature, measured judgment; solves problems independently but knows when to escalate or loop others in.
  • Takes full ownership of their work: consistently meets commitments and delivers quality without close supervision.

Minimum qualifications & skills:

  • 2–5 years of partnership/channel marketing experience. Affiliate marketing background required; direct exposure to content partnerships, AEO, or retail media is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of self-generating new business.
  • Proven excellence in meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Knowledge of affiliate networks, including Impact, Partnerize, CJ, and Awin.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for client meetings, industry conferences, and events.

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!
  • Target Salary is $70,000 - $85,000 depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

 

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

 

#LI-REMOTE

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:

Veeam is seeking a Senior Partner Manager – Data & AI Security to grow our Securiti practice across our most strategic partners. Reporting into channel leadership, you’ll drive Data & AI Security channel sales for high-priority national and regional partners alongside Veeam Channel Managers, who own the relationship.

You’ll shape Veeam’s channel go-to-market for Data & AI Security, building replicable playbooks, campaigns, and playbooks to uncover Securiti business. You’re a channel leader who has built new practices within established partners, drives accountability without friction, and brings deep domain expertise, sales enablement capabilities, and executive credibility.

What You'll Do:

Pipeline & Revenue

  • Own Data & AI Security partner revenue and pipeline targets, including planning and forecasting.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through account mapping, joint campaigns and co-selling, and support high-value deals through close.

Channel Strategy

  • Lead Data & AI Security strategy and pipeline motion in each partnership; Veeam Channel Managers retain relationship ownership.
  • Build rules of engagement, playbooks and frameworks that scale the overlay model.
  • Represent partners to internal teams to shape programs, incentives, and roadmap.

Executive Engagement & Planning

  • Secure partner executive sponsorship for the Data & AI Security practice that each plan requires.
  • Assess partner potential and build multi-year joint business plans with revenue, enablement and services goals.
  • Lead Data & AI Security business reviews and hold stakeholders accountable to commitments.

Practice Development & Enablement

  • Recruit and activate partner sellers, engineers and services teams at scale.
  • Lead sales enablement across Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC.
  • Help partners build repeatable service offerings, sales plays and competitive positioning.

Measures of Success

  • Attainment of partner-sourced and partner-influenced Data & AI Security pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Number of strategic partners with an active, revenue-generating Data & AI Security practice, and growth in registered opportunities, net-new customers and average deal size.
  • Execution of joint business plans and the strength of executive alignment with partners and Veeam channel leadership.
  • Adoption of partner-led assessments, services and solutions, and partner participation in enablement and certification.
  • Scalability of the playbooks and programs developed, and their adoption across the wider channel team.
  • Forecast accuracy and return on partner marketing and enablement investment.

What You'll Bring:

  • Significant channel or alliances experience managing strategic or national-level partners.
  • A record of exceeding revenue targets through VARs, MSPs, and/or GSIs.
  • Success building a new practice within established partners in an overlay model.
  • Experience shaping channel strategy and executing it.
  • Executive presence with C-level partner leaders.
  • Command of partner-led selling, pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Cybersecurity, data governance, privacy or AI security expertise, fluent in DSPM, AI Governance and GRC.
  • Ability to turn technical capabilities into business outcomes and to influence without authority.
  • Experience mentoring peers and channel teams and guiding sales reps through partner processes.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with DSPM, AI governance, privacy or GRC platforms.
  • Experience building partner-led services practices.
  • Security, privacy or cloud certifications (e.g., CIPP, CISSP).

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive 4 on our High Tech team!

About the job

This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling and closing new business opportunities across our Messaging, Voice and Email products. In this role, you will be directly responsible for expanding our messaging business with some of the largest and fastest growing mid-market and enterprise companies in the High Tech vertical. New Business Account Executives are experts in the CPaaS ecosystem and Twilio’s product offerings. This role is highly cross functional, with deep integration with product management, carrier relations, finance, and solutions engineering teams.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Drive new customer acquisition, while being assigned a quota for iACV (incremental Account Contract Value)
  • Own highly analytical and consultative sales cycles to win business in competitive vendor sourcing cycles with Twilio’s messaging (e.g. SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Google Business Messages, Account Security, etc.), voice and email solutions.
  • Work with customers across assigned verticals (Financial Services) to understand their business and technical requirements, and match them to the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform, designing a solution for their specific use cases.
  • Work with teams in Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Operations to design mutually beneficial contracts to address customer requirements, while balancing the needs of our business.
  • Be passionate about what you do, think outside the box, and use world-class interpersonal and communication skills to present complex contractual, technical, and financial details to prospects in a way that builds confidence and comfort in the proposed solution.
  • Balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects and deals at the same time.
  • Partner cross functionally with sales, services, product, and finance to develop long range territory strategies and sales plans.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Twilio’s product and carrier relations teams.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the CPaaS industry - staying up to date on key industry initiatives and new capabilities - on behalf of your customers and the wider Twilio go-to-market organization.
  • Generate and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce.
  • Stay current with industry changes and collaborate with your team and peers to learn and share best practices

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Possess a total of 8 years of tech sales experience, with a minimum of 6 years in a closing role
  • Directly selling technical SaaS or CPaaS and experience solution selling and multi-threading
  • Experience outbound prospecting into new accounts and a strong “hunter” mentality for bringing in Mid-Market and Enterprise sized accounts
  • Technical solutions selling experience working with real customers and prospects, listening to them, and solving problems
  • Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships
  • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value
  • Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define process and build programs
  • Record of delivering market driven results, especially to scale and enterprise customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English)
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience

Desired:

  • Deep experience working with telecom companies, including CPAAS, SMS aggregators, carriers, or global communications platforms.
  • Domain expertise from a highly quantitative industry such as DevOps, Fintech, advertising optimization, investment banking, security or commodity trading especially in non-standard segments.
  • Software, SaaS, CPaas or PaaS selling experienc

Location

This role will be emote and located in the United States.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 20% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $110,160 - $137,700.
  • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $116,280- $145,350.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $122,400 - $153,300. This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 20th, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.jobDescription:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com

Mattermost is seeking a Senior Account Executive – Federal (Intelligence Community Focus) to own and expand one of our most strategic territories, centered on the U.S. Intelligence Community.

This is a quota-carrying individual contributor role focused exclusively on strategic selling, renewal expansion, and net-new growth across the IC ecosystem. The territory includes a significant multi-million-dollar renewal footprint and substantial opportunity for expansion across
IC agencies, program offices, and mission-aligned organizations operating in some of the most sensitive and demanding environments in the world.

The ideal candidate brings deep IC domain expertise, established relationships across agency acquisition and mission stakeholders, and experience working with Federal Systems Integrators and cleared partners to accelerate program-level adoption.

What You'll Do

Own and Grow the Intelligence Community Territory

  • Serve as the primary seller responsible for Mattermost's IC business, including agencies across the IC, program offices, and mission-aligned stakeholders operating in classified and controlled environments
  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies aligned to IC modernization, zero trust initiatives, and mission priorities
  • Expand Mattermost's footprint across additional agencies and programs through strategic penetration and executive alignment

Drive Strategic Renewals and Expansion Outcomes

  • Maintain executive ownership of large-scale renewals and expansion motions across the territory
  • Partner closely with an Account Manager who supports renewal execution, while retaining accountability for strategic renewal outcomes
  • Identify cross-agency and cross-program expansion opportunities within existing deployments

Close Complex Enterprise SaaS Transactions

  • Lead sophisticated, multi-threaded sales cycles involving technical validation, security review, accreditation workflows, and executive sponsorship
  • Navigate IC-specific procurement environments, including FAR/DFARS requirements, classified contracting workflows, and common contract vehicles (IDIQs, GWACs, OTAs)
  • Build strong internal deal governance and forecasting discipline through Salesforce

Execute a Federal Partner Ecosystem Motion

  • Develop and manage strategic co-sell relationships with major cleared Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs), including Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, SAIC, Northrop Grumman, Palantir, and others operating within the IC
  • Partner effectively with Federal distributors and cleared VARs to navigate contract vehicles, renewal workflows, and net-new agency entry
  • Align with partner capture teams and distributor resources to position Mattermost within prime contracts, task orders, and program-level pursuits
  • Maintain clear ownership of deal strategy and close execution while leveraging partners to accelerate procurement and expand reach

Deliver Predictable Revenue and Forecast Accountability

  • Carry and achieve an annual quota across net-new and strategic expansion outcomes
  • Maintain high forecast accuracy, deal hygiene, and pipeline rigor
  • Provide clear visibility to Sales leadership and Finance on deal timing, risks, and execution plans

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Proven track record of enterprise SaaS sales experience with demonstrated success closing complex, multi-million-dollar transactions
  • Substantial experience selling directly into U.S. Intelligence Community agencies with a deep understanding of IC acquisition, accreditation, and mission environments
  • Demonstrated success navigating IC-specific procurement, classification requirements, and authorization-to-operate (ATO) processes
  • Experience co-selling with cleared Federal Systems Integrators and navigating partner-influenced deal structures within the IC
  • Deep understanding of IC procurement, acquisition, and contracting processes

Clearance Requirements

  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
  • Active Secret clearance required
  • TS/SCI strongly preferred; polygraph is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling secure collaboration, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, or mission-critical infrastructure software into IC environments
  • Familiarity with IC-specific compliance and security frameworks including ICD 503, NIST 800-53, and cross-domain solution requirements
  • Experience supporting deployments in controlled or classified environments (IL4/IL5/IL6/TS networks)
  • Established relationships within key IC agency acquisition stakeholders and cleared FSI partner ecosystems
  • Familiarity with IC-specific contract vehicles and procurement pathways including ODNI, NSA, CIA, DIA, and other agency-specific vehicles

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

  • Successfully retain and expand major IC renewal footprint
  • Build executive-level relationships across IC agency acquisition and mission hierarchies
  • Establish repeatable co-sell execution with strategic cleared FSIs
  • Close net-new program opportunities across IC agencies and program offices
  • Deliver predictable, finance-ready forecasting and pipeline visibility

Why Mattermost

Mattermost is uniquely positioned at the intersection of secure collaboration, mission software, and intelligence community modernization. Our platform is built for the environments where security is not a feature — it is the foundation. This role offers the opportunity to shape and scale Mattermost's presence within one of the most strategically important and security-sensitive markets in the world.

If you thrive in complex, classified environments, understand how mission outcomes drive technology adoption, and want to sell software that protects the nation's most sensitive operations — we would love to hear from you.

Target Salary Range: $125,000 – $150,000 USD, plus commission

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Compensation may vary depending on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance. Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered. For more information visit Security Clearances — United States Department of State

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.
